#!/bin/bash

# concat_code.sh - Concatenate all code files into a single file with separators.
# Usage: ./concat_code.sh [SOURCE_DIR] [OUTPUT_FILE]
#   SOURCE_DIR   Directory to scan (default: current directory ".")
#   OUTPUT_FILE  Output file path   (default: "all_code.txt")
#
# Examples:
#   ./concat_code.sh
#   ./concat_code.sh ./my_project combined.txt

set -euo pipefail

SOURCE_DIR="${1:-.}"
OUTPUT_FILE="${2:-all_code.txt}"

# Resolve to absolute paths so we can safely exclude the output file
SOURCE_DIR="$(cd "$SOURCE_DIR" && pwd)"
mkdir -p "$(dirname "$OUTPUT_FILE")"
OUTPUT_FILE="$(cd "$(dirname "$OUTPUT_FILE")" && pwd)/$(basename "$OUTPUT_FILE")"

if [[ ! -d "$SOURCE_DIR" ]]; then
    echo "Error: '$SOURCE_DIR' is not a directory." >&2
    exit 1
fi

# ---- File extensions to include -------------------------------------------
EXTENSIONS=(
    # Web / React / Node
    js jsx mjs cjs ts tsx html htm css scss sass less
    # Data / config / docs
    json yaml yml toml ini cfg conf xml sql md markdown txt
    # Shell scripts
    sh bash zsh
)

# Build a find expression: -iname '*.ext' -o -iname '*.ext' ...
FIND_ARGS=()
first=1
for ext in "${EXTENSIONS[@]}"; do
    if [[ $first -eq 1 ]]; then
        FIND_ARGS+=( -iname "*.${ext}" )
        first=0
    else
        FIND_ARGS+=( -o -iname "*.${ext}" )
    fi
done

# Directories to skip entirely
PRUNE_DIRS=( 
    .git .svn .hg node_modules dist build target out bin obj
    .idea .vscode .venv venv env __pycache__ .pytest_cache
    .mypy_cache .tox .cache coverage .next .nuxt public/icons
)

PRUNE_EXPR=()
for d in "${PRUNE_DIRS[@]}"; do
    PRUNE_EXPR+=( -name "$d" -o )
done
# Drop the trailing -o
unset 'PRUNE_EXPR[${#PRUNE_EXPR[@]}-1]'

# ---- Collect files ---------------------------------------------------------
echo "Scanning: $SOURCE_DIR"
echo "Writing : $OUTPUT_FILE"

mapfile -t FILES < <(
    find "$SOURCE_DIR" \
        \( "${PRUNE_EXPR[@]}" \) -prune -o \
        -type f \( "${FIND_ARGS[@]}" \) -print \
    | grep -vxF "$OUTPUT_FILE" \
    | grep -v "/.env" \
    | grep -v "package-lock.json" \
    | sort
)

if [[ ${#FILES[@]} -eq 0 ]]; then
    echo "No matching files found." >&2
    exit 1
fi

# ---- Write output ----------------------------------------------------------
: > "$OUTPUT_FILE"

total=0
for f in "${FILES[@]}"; do
    rel="${f#"$SOURCE_DIR"/}"
    {
        echo
        echo "================================================================================"
        echo "FILE: $rel"
        echo "PATH: $f"
        echo "SIZE: $(stat -c%s "$f") bytes    LINES: $(wc -l < "$f")"
        echo "================================================================================"
        echo
    } >> "$OUTPUT_FILE"

    # Warn on binary files (contains NUL byte) and skip their content
    if grep -Iq . "$f"; then
        cat "$f" >> "$OUTPUT_FILE"
    else
        echo "[binary file skipped]" >> "$OUTPUT_FILE"
    fi

    # Ensure a trailing newline before the next separator
    [[ -s "$OUTPUT_FILE" && "$(tail -c1 "$OUTPUT_FILE")" != "" ]] && echo >> "$OUTPUT_FILE"

    (( total++ )) || true
done

echo
echo "Done. Concatenated $total files into:"
echo "  $OUTPUT_FILE ($(du -h "$OUTPUT_FILE" | cut -f1))"

// generate-seed.cjs
const XLSX = require('xlsx');
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');

const INPUT_DIR = path.resolve(__dirname, 'import-files');
const OUTPUT_FILE = path.resolve(__dirname, 'src', 'db', 'seedData.js');

const allRows = [];
const yearCounts = {};

if (!fs.existsSync(INPUT_DIR)) {
  console.error(`❌ Error: Folder not found: ${INPUT_DIR}`);
  process.exit(1);
}

const files = fs.readdirSync(INPUT_DIR).filter(f => f.endsWith('.xlsx'));
console.log(`Found ${files.length} .xlsx files.`);

files.forEach(file => {
  console.log(`Processing ${file}...`);
  const workbook = XLSX.readFile(path.join(INPUT_DIR, file));

  workbook.SheetNames.forEach(sheetName => {
    const sheet = workbook.Sheets[sheetName];
    const rows = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(sheet, { defval: null, raw: true });

    rows.forEach(row => {
      const getVal = (key) => {
        if (row[key] !== undefined) return row[key];
        const lowerKey = key.toLowerCase();
        const actualKey = Object.keys(row).find(k => k.toLowerCase() === lowerKey);
        return actualKey ? row[actualKey] : null;
      };

      const dateVal = getVal('date');
      const category = getVal('category');
      const subcategory = getVal('subcategory');
      const amountRaw =
        getVal('amount_original') !== null ? getVal('amount_original') : getVal('amount');
      const currency = getVal('currency') || 'MVR';
      const notes = getVal('notes') || '';

      if (!dateVal || !category) return;

      // Robust numeric check: catches null, undefined, '', 'abc', NaN.
      const amount = Number(amountRaw);
      if (!Number.isFinite(amount) || amount === 0) return;

      let parsedDate;
      if (typeof dateVal === 'number') {
        const excelEpoch = new Date(Date.UTC(1899, 11, 30));
        parsedDate = new Date(excelEpoch.getTime() + dateVal * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
      } else {
        parsedDate = new Date(dateVal);
      }

      if (isNaN(parsedDate.getTime())) return;

      const isoDate = parsedDate.toISOString();
      const year = parsedDate.getFullYear();

      yearCounts[year] = (yearCounts[year] || 0) + 1;

      const type = String(category).toLowerCase().includes('income') ? 'Income' : 'Expense';

      const rate = String(currency).toUpperCase() === 'USD' ? 15.42 : 1;
      const amount_mvr = amount * rate;

      let bucket = 'Discretionary';

      if (type === 'Income') {
        bucket = 'Income';
      } else if (['Debt', 'Pension', 'Zakat', 'Loan Repayment'].includes(subcategory)) {
        bucket = 'Financial/Obligatory';
      } else if (
        [
          'Bills', 'Medical', 'Tickets', 'Transportation', 'Grocery',
          'Samu', 'General', 'Water', 'Electricity', 'Food', 'Rent', 'Bappa',
        ].includes(subcategory)
      ) {
        bucket = 'Essential';
      }

      allRows.push({
        date: isoDate,
        category: String(category).trim(),
        subcategory: String(subcategory || '').trim(),
        amount_original: amount,
        currency: String(currency).toUpperCase(),
        exchange_rate_at_time: rate,
        amount_mvr,
        type,
        bucket,
        is_historical: true,
        notes: String(notes).trim(),
      });
    });
  });
});

const uniqueRows = Array.from(new Set(allRows.map(r => JSON.stringify(r)))).map(s => JSON.parse(s));

const fileContent = `// Auto-generated by generate-seed.cjs\n// Do not edit directly\nexport const SEED_DATA = ${JSON.stringify(uniqueRows, null, 2)};\n`;
fs.writeFileSync(OUTPUT_FILE, fileContent);

console.log(`\n✅ Successfully generated seedData.js with ${uniqueRows.length} rows!`);
console.log('Breakdown by year:', yearCounts);

// public/sw.js

const CACHE_NAME = 'finance-erp-v2';

self.addEventListener('install', () => {
  self.skipWaiting();
});

self.addEventListener('activate', (event) => {
  event.waitUntil(
    caches.keys().then((cacheNames) => {
      return Promise.all(
        cacheNames.map((cacheName) => {
          if (cacheName !== CACHE_NAME) {
            return caches.delete(cacheName);
          }
        })
      );
    })
  );
  self.clients.claim();
});

self.addEventListener('fetch', (event) => {
  if (event.request.method !== 'GET') return;

  // Never cache Supabase API or auth traffic:
  // - API responses are user-scoped and would leak between sessions.
  // - Cached API data would short-circuit fresh pulls.
  try {
    const url = new URL(event.request.url);
    if (url.pathname.startsWith('/rest/') || url.pathname.startsWith('/auth/')) {
      return;
    }
  } catch {
    // If URL parsing fails, fall through to normal handling.
  }

  event.respondWith(
    fetch(event.request)
      .then((response) => {
        const responseClone = response.clone();
        caches.open(CACHE_NAME).then((cache) => {
          cache.put(event.request, responseClone);
        });
        return response;
      })
      .catch(() => {
        return caches.match(event.request);
      })
  );
});

# React + Vite

This template provides a minimal setup to get React working in Vite with HMR and some ESLint rules.

Currently, two official plugins are available:

- [@vitejs/plugin-react](https://github.com/vitejs/vite-plugin-react/blob/main/packages/plugin-react) uses [Oxc](https://oxc.rs)
- [@vitejs/plugin-react-swc](https://github.com/vitejs/vite-plugin-react/blob/main/packages/plugin-react-swc) uses [SWC](https://swc.rs/)

## React Compiler

The React Compiler is not enabled on this template because of its impact on dev & build performances. To add it, see [this documentation](https://react.dev/learn/react-compiler/installation).

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useStore } from './store/useStore';
import { initSettings } from './db/database';
import { Plus, CreditCard, Settings, RefreshCw } from 'lucide-react';
import { supabase } from './lib/supabaseClient';
import { syncAll } from './lib/sync';
import { AuthGate } from './components/AuthGate';

import { MonthPicker } from './components/MonthPicker';
import { AppTabs } from './components/AppTabs';
import { ZakatCard } from './components/ZakatCard';
import { TotalDebtCard } from './components/TotalDebtCard';
import { CategoryTotals } from './components/CategoryTotals';
import { BucketBalances } from './components/BucketBalances';
import { RecentTransactions } from './components/RecentTransactions';
import { AddTransactionModal } from './components/AddTransactionModal';
import { ZakatPaidModal } from './components/ZakatPaidModal';
import { LoansModal } from './components/LoansModal';
import { SettingsModal } from './components/SettingsModal';
import { YearlySummary } from './components/YearlySummary';
import { RangeReport } from './components/RangeReport';
import { InsightsTab } from './components/InsightsTab';

const TABS = [
  { key: 'dashboard', label: 'Dashboard' },
  { key: 'insights', label: 'Insights' },
  { key: 'summary', label: 'Summary' },
  { key: 'range', label: 'Range' },
];

function MainApp() {
  const {
    loadData, isLoading, settings, getBucketBalances, getCategoryTotals,
    calculateZakat, addTransaction, updateTransaction, deleteTransaction,
    getMonthTransactions, bucketMap, getBucketFromMap, getSubcategoriesFor,
    getCategories, updateSetting, loans, getLoanPaid, getTotalDebtPayable
  } = useStore();
  
  const [selectedMonth, setSelectedMonth] = useState(new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 7));
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState('dashboard');
  const [isModalOpen, setIsModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editingTransaction, setEditingTransaction] = useState(null);
  const [isSettingsOpen, setIsSettingsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isZakatPaidOpen, setIsZakatPaidOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isLoansOpen, setIsLoansOpen] = useState(false);
  const [includeHistorical, setIncludeHistorical] = useState(false);
  const [isSyncing, setIsSyncing] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    initSettings().then(() => loadData());
  }, [loadData]);

  const handleManualSync = async () => {
    setIsSyncing(true);
    await syncAll();
    await loadData();
    setIsSyncing(false);
  };

  if (isLoading) return <div className="p-10 text-center text-gray-500">Loading Finance ERP...</div>;

  const buckets = getBucketBalances(selectedMonth);
  const zakat = calculateZakat(selectedMonth);
  const { totals, grandTotal } = getCategoryTotals(selectedMonth, includeHistorical);
  const monthTransactions = getMonthTransactions(selectedMonth, includeHistorical);
  const totalDebt = getTotalDebtPayable();
  const allCategories = getCategories();

  const handleEdit = (t) => {
    setEditingTransaction(t);
    setIsModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleDelete = async (id) => {
    if (window.confirm('Delete this transaction?')) {
      await deleteTransaction(id);
    }
  };

  const handleMarkZakatPaid = async (amount) => {
    await addTransaction({
      type: 'Expense',
      category: 'Personal',
      subcategory: 'Zakat',
      amount_original: amount,
      currency: 'MVR',
      bucket: 'Financial/Obligatory',
      notes: `Zakat paid for ${selectedMonth}`,
      date: new Date().toISOString()
    });
    setIsZakatPaidOpen(false);
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-50 pb-24 font-sans overflow-x-hidden">
      <header className="bg-white sticky top-0 z-30 p-3 shadow-sm">
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 max-w-4xl mx-auto">
          <h1 className="text-xl font-bold text-gray-800">Finance ERP</h1>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
              <MonthPicker selectedMonth={selectedMonth} onChange={setSelectedMonth} />
            </div>
            <button 
              onClick={handleManualSync}
              disabled={isSyncing}
              className="p-2 text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-800 hover:bg-gray-100 rounded-lg flex-shrink-0"
              title="Sync Now"
            >
              <RefreshCw size={20} className={isSyncing ? "animate-spin" : ""} />
            </button>
            <button 
              onClick={() => setIsLoansOpen(true)}
              className="p-2 text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-800 hover:bg-gray-100 rounded-lg flex-shrink-0 relative"
              title="Loans"
            >
              <CreditCard size={20} />
              {loans.length > 0 && (
                <span className="absolute -top-0.5 -right-0.5 bg-red-500 text-white text-[10px] rounded-full w-4 h-4 flex items-center justify-center font-bold">
                  {loans.length}
                </span>
              )}
            </button>
            <button 
              onClick={() => setIsSettingsOpen(true)}
              className="p-2 text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-800 hover:bg-gray-100 rounded-lg flex-shrink-0"
            >
              <Settings size={20} />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </header>

      <AppTabs active={activeTab} onChange={setActiveTab} tabs={TABS} />

      <div className="p-3 max-w-4xl mx-auto overflow-hidden">
        {activeTab === 'dashboard' && (
          <>
            <div className="flex justify-end mb-2">
              <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-gray-600 select-none bg-white px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg shadow-sm">
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={includeHistorical}
                  onChange={(e) => setIncludeHistorical(e.target.checked)}
                  className="accent-blue-600"
                />
                Include Historical
              </label>
            </div>

            <ZakatCard
              zakat={zakat}
              selectedMonth={selectedMonth}
              onMarkPaid={() => setIsZakatPaidOpen(true)}
            />
            <TotalDebtCard
              totalDebt={totalDebt}
              loans={loans}
              onManage={() => setIsLoansOpen(true)}
            />
            <CategoryTotals totals={totals} grandTotal={grandTotal} />
            <BucketBalances buckets={buckets} />
            <RecentTransactions
              transactions={monthTransactions}
              onEdit={handleEdit}
              onDelete={handleDelete}
            />
          </>
        )}

        {activeTab === 'insights' && <InsightsTab selectedMonth={selectedMonth} />}
        {activeTab === 'summary' && <YearlySummary />}
        {activeTab === 'range' && <RangeReport allCategories={allCategories} />}
      </div>

      <button
        onClick={() => { setEditingTransaction(null); setIsModalOpen(true); }}
        className="fixed bottom-6 right-6 bg-blue-600 text-white p-4 rounded-full shadow-lg hover:bg-blue-700 transition-transform active:scale-95 z-20"
      >
        <Plus size={28} />
      </button>

      {isModalOpen && (
        <AddTransactionModal
          onClose={() => { setIsModalOpen(false); setEditingTransaction(null); }}
          onSave={async (data) => {
            if (editingTransaction) {
              await updateTransaction(editingTransaction.id, data);
            } else {
              await addTransaction(data);
            }
            setIsModalOpen(false);
            setEditingTransaction(null);
          }}
          settings={settings}
          initialData={editingTransaction}
          getBucketFromMap={getBucketFromMap}
          getSubcategoriesFor={getSubcategoriesFor}
          getCategories={getCategories}
          loans={loans}
        />
      )}

      {isSettingsOpen && (
        <SettingsModal
          onClose={() => setIsSettingsOpen(false)}
          settings={settings}
          updateSetting={updateSetting}
          bucketMap={bucketMap}
          updateBucketFor={useStore.getState().updateBucketFor}
          onDataChanged={() => useStore.getState().loadData()}
        />
      )}

      {isZakatPaidOpen && (
        <ZakatPaidModal
          onClose={() => setIsZakatPaidOpen(false)}
          onConfirm={handleMarkZakatPaid}
          suggestedAmount={zakat.zakatDue}
        />
      )}

      {isLoansOpen && (
        <LoansModal
          onClose={() => setIsLoansOpen(false)}
          loans={loans}
          getLoanPaid={getLoanPaid}
          addLoan={useStore.getState().addLoan}
          updateLoan={useStore.getState().updateLoan}
          deleteLoan={useStore.getState().deleteLoan}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function App() {
  return (
    <AuthGate>
      <MainApp />
    </AuthGate>
  );
}

export default App;

import { useState } from 'react';
import { X, ArrowDownCircle, ArrowUpCircle } from 'lucide-react';
import { CustomSelect } from './CustomSelect';

export function AddTransactionModal({
  onClose,
  onSave,
  settings,
  initialData,
  getBucketFromMap,
  getSubcategoriesFor,
  getCategories,
  loans,
}) {
  const [type, setType] = useState(initialData?.type || 'Expense');
  const [category, setCategory] = useState(initialData?.category || 'Personal');
  const [subcategory, setSubcategory] = useState(initialData?.subcategory || '');
  const [amount, setAmount] = useState(initialData?.amount_original || '');
  const [currency, setCurrency] = useState(initialData?.currency || 'MVR');
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState(initialData?.notes || '');
  const [loanUuid, setLoanUuid] = useState(initialData?.loan_uuid || '');

  const isIncome = type === 'Income';
  const allCategories = getCategories();
  const availableCategories = isIncome
    ? ['Income']
    : allCategories.filter(c => c !== 'Income');

  const availableSubcategories = getSubcategoriesFor(category);

  const derivedBucket = isIncome ? 'Income' : getBucketFromMap(category, subcategory);
  const isLoanRepayment =
    !isIncome && category === 'Personal' && subcategory === 'Loan Repayment';

  const handleTypeChange = (newType) => {
    setType(newType);
    if (newType === 'Income') setCategory('Income');
    else setCategory('Personal');
    setSubcategory('');
    setLoanUuid('');
  };

  const handleCategoryChange = (newCat) => {
    setCategory(newCat);
    setSubcategory('');
    setLoanUuid('');
  };

  const handleSubcategoryChange = (newSub) => {
    setSubcategory(newSub);
    if (!(category === 'Personal' && newSub === 'Loan Repayment')) {
      setLoanUuid('');
    }
  };

  const handleSubmit = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!amount || !subcategory) return;
    if (isLoanRepayment && !loanUuid) {
      alert('Please select which loan this repayment is for.');
      return;
    }

    onSave({
      type,
      category,
      subcategory,
      amount_original: parseFloat(amount),
      currency,
      bucket: derivedBucket,
      notes,
      loan_uuid: isLoanRepayment ? loanUuid : null,
      exchange_rate_at_time: initialData?.exchange_rate_at_time,
    });
  };

  const loanDisplay = loans.map(l => ({
    id: l.uuid,
    label: `${l.name} (RF ${l.total_amount.toFixed(2)})`,
  }));
  const selectedLoanLabel =
    loanDisplay.find(l => String(l.id) === String(loanUuid))?.label || '';

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/50 z-50 flex items-end sm:items-center justify-center">
      <div className="bg-white w-full max-w-md rounded-t-2xl sm:rounded-2xl p-5 max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto">
        <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-4">
          <h2 className="text-lg font-bold">{initialData ? 'Edit' : 'Add'} Transaction</h2>
          <button onClick={onClose} className="text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600">
            <X size={24} />
          </button>
        </div>

        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
          <div className="flex gap-2 bg-gray-100 p-1 rounded-lg">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => handleTypeChange('Expense')}
              className={`flex-1 py-2 rounded-md text-sm font-semibold transition ${
                type === 'Expense' ? 'bg-white text-red-600 shadow' : 'text-gray-500'
              }`}
            >
              <ArrowDownCircle size={14} className="inline mr-1" /> Expense
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => handleTypeChange('Income')}
              className={`flex-1 py-2 rounded-md text-sm font-semibold transition ${
                type === 'Income' ? 'bg-white text-green-600 shadow' : 'text-gray-500'
              }`}
            >
              <ArrowUpCircle size={14} className="inline mr-1" /> Income
            </button>
          </div>

          <div>
            <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 mb-1 block">Amount</label>
            <div className="flex gap-2 items-stretch">
              <input
                type="number"
                step="0.01"
                required
                value={amount}
                onChange={(e) => setAmount(e.target.value)}
                className="flex-1 min-w-0 p-3 bg-gray-50 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 focus:border-blue-500 outline-none text-lg font-bold"
                placeholder="0.00"
              />
              <div className="w-24 flex-shrink-0">
                <CustomSelect
                  value={currency}
                  onChange={setCurrency}
                  options={['MVR', 'USD']}
                  searchable={false}
                  required={true}
                  buttonClassName="font-semibold text-center"
                />
              </div>
            </div>
            {currency === 'USD' && (
              <div className="text-xs text-blue-600 mt-1">
                ≈ RF{' '}
                {(
                  parseFloat(amount || 0) * (settings.current_usd_rate || 15.42)
                ).toFixed(2)}{' '}
                @ {settings.current_usd_rate} MVR/USD
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          <div>

            <CustomSelect
              value={category}
              onChange={handleCategoryChange}
              options={availableCategories}
              required={true}
            />

                  No loans yet. Add one via the Loans button in the header first.
                </div>
              ) : (
                <CustomSelect
                  value={selectedLoanLabel}
                  onChange={(label) => {
                    const found = loanDisplay.find(l => l.label === label);
                    setLoanUuid(found ? found.id : '');
                  }}
                  options={loanDisplay.map(l => l.label)}
                  placeholder="-- Select loan --"
                  required={true}
                  searchable={false}
                />
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          {type === 'Expense' && subcategory && !isLoanRepayment && (
            <div
              className={`p-3 rounded-lg flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-semibold ${
                derivedBucket === 'Essential'
                  ? 'bg-green-50 text-green-700 border border-green-200'
                  : derivedBucket === 'Discretionary'
                  ? 'bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 border border-blue-200'

              <span className="text-xs uppercase opacity-70">Auto Bucket:</span>

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { supabase } from '../lib/supabaseClient';
import { syncAll } from '../lib/sync';
import { Loader2, Mail, AlertCircle } from 'lucide-react';

export function AuthGate({ children }) {
  const [session, setSession] = useState(null);
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [message, setMessage] = useState('');
  const [isSyncing, setIsSyncing] = useState(false);
  const [syncError, setSyncError] = useState(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    supabase.auth.getSession().then(({ data: { session } }) => {
      setSession(session);
      if (session) {
        triggerSync();
      } else {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    });

    const { data: { subscription } } = supabase.auth.onAuthStateChange((event, session) => {
      console.log('Auth Event:', event);
      if (event === 'SIGNED_IN') {
        setSession(session);
        if (!window.location.hash.includes('access_token')) {
          triggerSync();
        }
      }
    });

    return () => subscription.unsubscribe();
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  const triggerSync = async () => {
    setIsSyncing(true);
    setSyncError(null);
    try {
      console.log('Starting Sync...');
      await syncAll();
      console.log('Sync Complete!');
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('Sync failed:', e);
      setSyncError(e.message || String(e));
    } finally {
      setIsSyncing(false);
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleLogin = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setMessage('');
    const { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOtp({
      email,
      options: {
        emailRedirectTo: window.location.origin,
      },
    });
    if (error) {
      setMessage(error.message);
    } else {
      setMessage('Check your email for the magic link!');
    }
  };

  if (loading || isSyncing) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-gray-50 text-blue-600">
        <Loader2 size={32} className="animate-spin mb-4" />
        <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-500">
          {isSyncing ? 'Syncing your data from the cloud...' : 'Loading...'}
        </p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!session) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-gray-50 p-4">
        <div className="bg-white p-6 rounded-2xl shadow-md w-full max-w-sm">
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-center mb-2 text-gray-800">Finance ERP</h1>
          <p className="text-center text-gray-500 text-sm mb-6">Sign in to sync your data.</p>

          <form onSubmit={handleLogin} className="space-y-4">
            <div>
              <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 mb-1 block">Email Address</label>
              <div className="relative">
                <Mail
                  size={16}
                  className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-gray-400"
                />
                <input
                  type="email"
                  required
                  value={email}
                  onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full pl-9 p-3 bg-gray-50 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 outline-none focus:border-blue-500"
                  placeholder="you@example.com"
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            <button
              type="submit"
              className="w-full bg-blue-600 text-white py-3 rounded-lg font-bold hover:bg-blue-700 transition"
            >
              Send Magic Link
            </button>
          </form>

          {message && (
            <div
              className={`mt-4 p-3 rounded-lg text-sm text-center ${
                message.includes('Check')
                  ? 'bg-green-50 text-green-700'
                  : 'bg-red-50 text-red-700'
              }`}
            >
              {message}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <>
      {syncError && (
        <div className="fixed top-0 left-0 right-0 z-[100] bg-red-600 text-white text-sm p-3 flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 min-w-0">
            <AlertCircle size={16} className="flex-shrink-0" />
            <span className="truncate">Sync failed: {syncError}. Showing local data.</span>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={triggerSync}
            className="bg-white/20 hover:bg-white/30 px-3 py-1 rounded text-xs font-semibold flex-shrink-0"
          >
            Retry
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
      {children}
    </>
  );
}

import { useState, useRef } from 'react';
import { ChevronDown } from 'lucide-react';
import { useClickOutside } from '../hooks/useClickOutside';

const BUCKET_OPTIONS = ['Essential', 'Discretionary', 'Financial/Obligatory', 'Income'];

export function BucketDropdown({ currentValue, onSelect }) {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const ref = useRef(null);
  useClickOutside(ref, () => setIsOpen(false));

  const colorClasses = (val) => {
    if (val === 'Essential') return 'bg-green-100 text-green-700';
    if (val === 'Discretionary') return 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-700';
    if (val === 'Income') return 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-700';
    return 'bg-purple-100 text-purple-700';
  };

  const textColor = (val) => {
    if (val === 'Essential') return 'text-green-700';
    if (val === 'Discretionary') return 'text-blue-700';
    if (val === 'Income') return 'text-yellow-700';
    return 'text-purple-700';
  };

  return (
    <div ref={ref} className="relative w-full">
      <button 
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setIsOpen(!isOpen)}
        className={`text-xs font-semibold p-2 rounded-lg border-0 w-full text-left flex justify-between items-center ${colorClasses(currentValue)}`}
      >
        {currentValue}
        <ChevronDown size={14} className={`transition-transform ${isOpen ? 'rotate-180' : ''}`} />
      </button>
      
      {isOpen && (
        <div className="absolute z-50 mt-1 w-full bg-white rounded-lg shadow-lg border border-gray-200 overflow-hidden">
          {BUCKET_OPTIONS.map(opt => (
            <button
              key={opt}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => { onSelect(opt); setIsOpen(false); }}
              className={`w-full text-left p-2 text-xs font-semibold hover:bg-gray-100 ${textColor(opt)} ${opt === currentValue ? 'bg-gray-50' : ''}`}
            >
              {opt}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import { useState } from 'react';
import { ChevronDown, ChevronRight } from 'lucide-react';
import { formatMoney } from '../utils/format';

export function CategoryTotals({ totals, grandTotal }) {
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState({});

  const toggle = (category) => {
    setExpanded(prev => ({ ...prev, [category]: !prev[category] }));
  };

  return (
    <div className="mb-6">
      <div className="flex justify-between items-baseline mb-3">
        <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-800">Category Totals</h2>
        <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-500">Total: RF {formatMoney(grandTotal)}</span>
      </div>

      {totals.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="text-center p-8 text-gray-400 bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm text-sm">
          No expenses logged for this month yet.
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-2">
          {totals.map((item) => {
            const percentage = grandTotal > 0 ? (item.amount / grandTotal) * 100 : 0;
            const isOpen = !!expanded[item.category];
            const subs = item.subcategories || [];

            return (
              <div key={item.category} className="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm overflow-hidden relative">
                {/* Background share bar */}
                <div
                  className="absolute top-0 left-0 h-full bg-blue-50 opacity-60 pointer-events-none"
                  style={{ width: `${percentage}%` }}
                ></div>

                {/* Category row (clickable) */}
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => toggle(item.category)}
                  className="relative w-full text-left p-3 flex justify-between items-center gap-2 hover:bg-gray-50 transition"
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 min-w-0">
                    {isOpen
                      ? <ChevronDown size={16} className="text-gray-400 flex-shrink-0" />
                      : <ChevronRight size={16} className="text-gray-400 flex-shrink-0" />
                    }
                    <div className="min-w-0">
                      <div className="font-semibold text-gray-700 truncate">{item.category}</div>
                      <div className="text-xs text-gray-400">
                        {percentage.toFixed(1)}% of total
                        {subs.length > 0 && ` • ${subs.length} subcategor${subs.length === 1 ? 'y' : 'ies'}`}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="font-bold text-gray-800 flex-shrink-0">
                    RF {formatMoney(item.amount)}
                  </div>
                </button>

                {/* Subcategory breakdown */}
                {isOpen && subs.length > 0 && (
                  <div className="relative border-t border-gray-100 bg-gray-50/40">
                    {subs.map(sub => {
                      const subPct = item.amount > 0 ? (sub.amount / item.amount) * 100 : 0;
                      return (
                        <div
                          key={sub.subcategory}
                          className="flex justify-between items-center px-4 py-2 border-b border-gray-100 last:border-0"

import { useState, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
import { ChevronDown, Search } from 'lucide-react';
import { useClickOutside } from '../hooks/useClickOutside';

export function CustomSelect({ 
  value, 
  onChange, 
  options, 
  placeholder = '-- Select --',
  required = false,
  className = '',
  buttonClassName = '',
  searchable = true,
  disabled = false
}) {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const ref = useRef(null);
  const searchRef = useRef(null);
  useClickOutside(ref, () => setIsOpen(false));

  // Reset search when closed
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) setSearch('');
  }, [isOpen]);

  // Force focus on mobile to bring up keyboard immediately
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen && searchable && searchRef.current) {
      setTimeout(() => searchRef.current?.focus(), 100);
    }
  }, [isOpen, searchable]);

  // Always show search if searchable is true
  const showSearch = searchable;
  
  const filtered = showSearch && search.trim()
    ? options.filter(o => o.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()))
    : options;

  const displayValue = value || placeholder;
  const isPlaceholder = !value;

  const handleSelect = (opt) => {
    onChange(opt);
    setIsOpen(false);
  };

  return (
    <div ref={ref} className={`relative w-full ${className}`}>
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => !disabled && setIsOpen(!isOpen)}
        disabled={disabled}
        className={`w-full p-3 bg-gray-50 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 text-left flex justify-between items-center gap-2 ${
          disabled ? 'opacity-50 cursor-not-allowed' : 'hover:border-gray-300'
        } ${buttonClassName}`}
      >
        <span className={`text-sm truncate ${isPlaceholder ? 'text-gray-400' : 'text-gray-700'}`}>
          {displayValue}
        </span>
        <ChevronDown 
          size={16} 
          className={`text-gray-500 flex-shrink-0 transition-transform ${isOpen ? 'rotate-180' : ''}`} 
        />
      </button>

      {isOpen && (
        <div className="absolute z-50 mt-1 w-full bg-white rounded-lg shadow-lg border border-gray-200 overflow-hidden">
          {showSearch && (
            <div className="relative border-b border-gray-100">
              <Search size={14} className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-gray-400" />
              <input
                ref={searchRef}
                type="text"
                value={search}
                onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Search..."
                className="w-full pl-8 pr-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none"
              />
            </div>
          )}

          <div className="max-h-60 overflow-y-auto">
            {!required && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handleSelect('')}
                className={`w-full text-left px-3 py-2 text-sm hover:bg-gray-50 ${
                  !value ? 'bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 font-semibold' : 'text-gray-400 italic'
                }`}
              >
                {placeholder}
              </button>
            )}

            {filtered.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="px-3 py-4 text-xs text-gray-400 text-center">No matches.</div>
            ) : (
              filtered.map(opt => (
                <button
                  key={opt}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => handleSelect(opt)}
                  className={`w-full text-left px-3 py-2 text-sm hover:bg-gray-50 truncate ${
                    opt === value ? 'bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 font-semibold' : 'text-gray-700'
                  }`}
                >
                  {opt}
                </button>
              ))
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import { useState, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
import { ChevronDown, ChevronLeft, ChevronRight } from 'lucide-react';
import { useClickOutside } from '../hooks/useClickOutside';

const MONTH_NAMES_LONG = [
  'January', 'February', 'March', 'April', 'May', 'June',
  'July', 'August', 'September', 'October', 'November', 'December'
];
const MONTH_NAMES_SHORT = [
  'Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun',
  'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec'
];

export function DatePicker({ value, onChange }) {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [view, setView] = useState('days'); // 'days' | 'months' | 'years'
  
  // The currently selected date (for highlighting)
  const d = value ? new Date(value) : new Date();
  const validDate = isNaN(d.getTime()) ? new Date() : d;

  const [viewMonth, setViewMonth] = useState({
    year: validDate.getFullYear(),
    month: validDate.getMonth(),
  });

  const ref = useRef(null);
  useClickOutside(ref, () => setIsOpen(false));

  // Sync viewMonth when the value changes externally
  useEffect(() => {
    if (value) {
      const parsed = new Date(value);
      if (!isNaN(parsed)) {
        setViewMonth({ year: parsed.getFullYear(), month: parsed.getMonth() });
      }
    }
  }, [value]);

  // Reset the view to days when opening
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) setView('days');
  }, [isOpen]);

  const displayValue = value
    ? validDate.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { year: 'numeric', month: 'short', day: 'numeric' })
    : 'Select date';

  // --- Calendar Grid Calculation ---
  const daysInMonth = new Date(viewMonth.year, viewMonth.month + 1, 0).getDate();
  const firstDayOfWeek = new Date(viewMonth.year, viewMonth.month, 1).getDay();
  const days = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < firstDayOfWeek; i++) days.push(null);
  for (let d = 1; d <= daysInMonth; d++) days.push(d);

  const handleSelectDay = (day) => {
    const m = String(viewMonth.month + 1).padStart(2, '0');
    const dd = String(day).padStart(2, '0');
    onChange(`${viewMonth.year}-${m}-${dd}`);
    setIsOpen(false);
  };

  const goPrevMonth = () => {
    setViewMonth(v => v.month === 0 ? { year: v.year - 1, month: 11 } : { year: v.year, month: v.month - 1 });
  };

  const goNextMonth = () => {
    setViewMonth(v => v.month === 11 ? { year: v.year + 1, month: 0 } : { year: v.year, month: v.month + 1 });
  };

  const todayStr = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);

  // --- Year Grid Calculation ---
  // Show a block of 12 years (e.g. 2015 - 2026)
  const yearBlockStart = Math.floor(viewMonth.year / 12) * 12;
  const years = Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_, i) => yearBlockStart + i);

  return (
    <div ref={ref} className="relative w-full">
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setIsOpen(!isOpen)}
        className="w-full p-3 bg-gray-50 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 text-left flex justify-between items-center hover:border-gray-300 transition-colors"
      >
        <span className={`text-sm truncate ${!value ? 'text-gray-400' : 'text-gray-700'}`}>
          {displayValue}
        </span>
        <ChevronDown size={16} className={`text-gray-500 flex-shrink-0 transition-transform ${isOpen ? 'rotate-180' : ''}`} />
      </button>

      {isOpen && (
        <div className="absolute z-50 mt-1 w-[280px] bg-white rounded-xl shadow-xl border border-gray-200 p-3">
          
          {/* Header */}
          <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-3">
            {view === 'days' ? (
              <button type="button" onClick={goPrevMonth} className="p-1.5 text-gray-500 hover:bg-gray-100 rounded-lg w-8 h-8 flex items-center justify-center">
                <ChevronLeft size={16} />
              </button>
            ) : (
              <div className="w-8" /> // Spacer
            )}

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setView(view === 'days' ? 'months' : 'years')}
              className="font-bold text-sm text-gray-800 hover:bg-gray-100 px-2 py-1 rounded transition-colors"
            >
              {view === 'days' ? `${MONTH_NAMES_LONG[viewMonth.month]} ${viewMonth.year}` : 
               view === 'months' ? `${viewMonth.year}` : 
               `${yearBlockStart} - ${yearBlockStart + 11}`}
            </button>

            {view === 'days' ? (
              <button type="button" onClick={goNextMonth} className="p-1.5 text-gray-500 hover:bg-gray-100 rounded-lg w-8 h-8 flex items-center justify-center">
                <ChevronRight size={16} />
              </button>
            ) : (
              <div className="w-8" /> // Spacer
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Views */}
          {view === 'days' && (
            <>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-7 gap-1 mb-1">
                {['S','M','T','W','T','F','S'].map((d, i) => (
                  <div key={i} className="text-[10px] text-gray-400 text-center font-semibold">{d}</div>
                ))}
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-7 gap-1">
                {days.map((day, idx) => {
                  if (day === null) return <div key={idx}></div>;
                  const m = String(viewMonth.month + 1).padStart(2, '0');
                  const dd = String(day).padStart(2, '0');
                  const dateStr = `${viewMonth.year}-${m}-${dd}`;
                  const isSelected = dateStr === (value || '');
                  const isToday = dateStr === todayStr;
                  return (
                    <button
                      key={idx}
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => handleSelectDay(day)}
                      className={`aspect-square text-xs rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center transition-colors ${
                        isSelected
                          ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white font-bold shadow-md'
                          : isToday
                            ? 'bg-blue-50 text-blue-600 font-semibold border border-blue-100'
                            : 'hover:bg-gray-100 text-gray-700'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {day}
                    </button>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </>
          )}

          {view === 'months' && (
            <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 mt-2">
              {MONTH_NAMES_SHORT.map((month, idx) => {
                const isSelected = viewMonth.month === idx;
                return (
                  <button
                    key={month}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => {
                      setViewMonth(prev => ({ ...prev, month: idx }));
                      setView('days');
                    }}
                    className={`py-3 text-sm rounded-lg transition-colors ${
                      isSelected ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white font-bold shadow-md' : 'hover:bg-gray-100 text-gray-700'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {month}
                  </button>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          )}

          {view === 'years' && (
            <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 mt-2">
              {years.map(year => {
                const isSelected = viewMonth.year === year;
                return (
                  <button
                    key={year}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => {
                      setViewMonth(prev => ({ ...prev, year }));
                      setView('months'); // Jump to months after picking year
                    }}
                    className={`py-3 text-sm rounded-lg transition-colors ${
                      isSelected ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white font-bold shadow-md' : 'hover:bg-gray-100 text-gray-700'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {year}
                  </button>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Footer (only on day view) */}
          {view === 'days' && (
            <div className="flex gap-2 mt-3 pt-3 border-t border-gray-100">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => { onChange(''); setIsOpen(false); }}
                className="flex-1 text-xs text-gray-500 py-2 hover:bg-gray-50 rounded-lg transition-colors font-medium"
              >
                Clear
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => { onChange(todayStr); setIsOpen(false); }}
                className="flex-1 text-xs text-blue-600 py-2 hover:bg-blue-50 rounded-lg transition-colors font-bold"
              >
                Today
              </button>
            </div>
          )}

        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import { useState } from 'react';
import { X, Upload, CheckCircle, AlertCircle } from 'lucide-react';
import * as XLSX from 'xlsx';
import { db } from '../db/database';
import { CustomSelect } from './CustomSelect';

export function ImportModal({ onClose, onImportComplete }) {
  const [step, setStep] = useState(1);
  const [file, setFile] = useState(null);
  const [sheets, setSheets] = useState([]);
  const [selectedSheet, setSelectedSheet] = useState('');
  const [headers, setHeaders] = useState([]);
  const [rows, setRows] = useState([]);
  const [mapping, setMapping] = useState({});
  const [isImporting, setIsImporting] = useState(false);
  const [importResult, setImportResult] = useState(null);

  const DB_FIELDS = [
    { key: 'date', label: 'Date', required: true },
    { key: 'category', label: 'Category', required: true },
    { key: 'subcategory', label: 'Subcategory', required: false },
    { key: 'amount_original', label: 'Amount', required: true },
    { key: 'currency', label: 'Currency', required: false },
    { key: 'notes', label: 'Notes', required: false },
  ];

  const columnOptions = ['-- Skip --', ...headers.map((h, i) => h || `Column ${i + 1}`)];

  const handleFileUpload = (e) => {
    const uploadedFile = e.target.files[0];
    if (!uploadedFile) return;

    setFile(uploadedFile);
    const reader = new FileReader();

    reader.onload = (event) => {
      const data = new Uint8Array(event.target.result);
      const workbook = XLSX.read(data, { type: 'array' });
      setSheets(workbook.SheetNames);
      setSelectedSheet(workbook.SheetNames[0]);

      if (workbook.SheetNames.length === 1) {
        loadSheet(workbook, workbook.SheetNames[0]);
      } else {
        setStep(1.5);
      }
    };

    reader.readAsArrayBuffer(uploadedFile);
  };

  const loadSheet = (workbook, sheetName) => {
    const worksheet = workbook.Sheets[sheetName];
    const jsonData = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(worksheet, { header: 1, defval: '' });

    if (jsonData.length === 0) {
      alert('That sheet is empty.');
      return;
    }

    const headerRow = jsonData[0].map(h => String(h).trim());
    const dataRows = jsonData.slice(1).filter(row => row.some(cell => cell !== ''));

    setHeaders(headerRow);
    setRows(dataRows);

    const autoMap = {};
    DB_FIELDS.forEach(field => {
      const targetKey = field.key.toLowerCase();
      const targetLabel = field.label.toLowerCase();

      let idx = headerRow.findIndex(h => h.toLowerCase() === targetKey);
      if (idx === -1) idx = headerRow.findIndex(h => h.toLowerCase() === targetLabel);
      if (idx === -1) {
        idx = headerRow.findIndex(h => {
          const lower = h.toLowerCase();
          return lower.includes(targetKey) || lower.includes(targetLabel);
        });
      }

      if (idx !== -1) autoMap[field.key] = idx;
    });
    setMapping(autoMap);
    setStep(2);
  };

  const handleSheetSelect = (sheetName) => {
    setSelectedSheet(sheetName);
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = (event) => {
      const data = new Uint8Array(event.target.result);
      const workbook = XLSX.read(data, { type: 'array' });
      loadSheet(workbook, sheetName);
    };
    reader.readAsArrayBuffer(file);
  };

  const handleMapChange = (dbField, selectedLabel) => {
    if (!selectedLabel || selectedLabel === '-- Skip --') {
      setMapping({ ...mapping, [dbField]: undefined });
      return;
    }
    const idx = columnOptions.indexOf(selectedLabel) - 1;
    setMapping({ ...mapping, [dbField]: idx });
  };

  const handleImport = async () => {
    setIsImporting(true);
    let successCount = 0;
    let errorCount = 0;

    try {
      const batch = [];

      for (let i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
        const row = rows[i];
        if (!row || row.length === 0) continue;

        const dateVal = mapping.date !== undefined ? row[mapping.date] : null;
        const catVal = mapping.category !== undefined ? row[mapping.category] : null;
        const subVal = mapping.subcategory !== undefined ? row[mapping.subcategory] : '';
        const amtVal = mapping.amount_original !== undefined ? row[mapping.amount_original] : null;
        const currVal = mapping.currency !== undefined ? row[mapping.currency] : 'MVR';
        const notesVal = mapping.notes !== undefined ? row[mapping.notes] : '';

        if (!dateVal || !catVal || amtVal === null || amtVal === '') {
          errorCount++;
          continue;
        }

        let finalDate;
        if (typeof dateVal === 'number') {
          const excelEpoch = new Date(Date.UTC(1899, 11, 30));
          const msPerDay = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
          finalDate = new Date(excelEpoch.getTime() + dateVal * msPerDay).toISOString();
        } else if (typeof dateVal === 'string') {
          const ddmmyyyy = dateVal.match(/^(\d{1,2})[\/\-](\d{1,2})[\/\-](\d{2,4})$/);
          if (ddmmyyyy) {
            const [, d, m, yRaw] = ddmmyyyy;
            const y = yRaw.length === 2 ? '20' + yRaw : yRaw;
            const dt = new Date(Number(y), Number(m) - 1, Number(d), 12, 0, 0);
            finalDate = dt.toISOString();
          } else {
            const parsed = new Date(dateVal);
            finalDate = isNaN(parsed.getTime()) ? new Date().toISOString() : parsed.toISOString();
          }
        } else {
          finalDate = new Date().toISOString();
        }

        const numericAmount = parseFloat(String(amtVal).replace(/[^0-9.-]+/g, ''));
        if (isNaN(numericAmount)) {
          errorCount++;
          continue;
        }

        const type = String(catVal).toLowerCase().includes('income') ? 'Income' : 'Expense';
        const currency = String(currVal).toUpperCase() === 'USD' ? 'USD' : 'MVR';
        // For historical rows, we set exchange_rate to 15.42 but the rate is stored.
        // The app's logic will use the stored amount_mvr.
        const rate = currency === 'USD' ? 15.42 : 1; 
        const amount_mvr = currency === 'USD' ? numericAmount * rate : numericAmount;

        batch.push({
          date: finalDate,
          category: String(catVal).trim(),
          subcategory: String(subVal).trim(),
          amount_original: numericAmount,
          currency: currency,
          amount_mvr: amount_mvr,
          exchange_rate_at_time: rate,
          type: type,
          is_historical: true,
          notes: String(notesVal).trim(),
          bucket: 'Discretionary' // Fallback bucket for imported data
        });
      }

      const BATCH_SIZE = 1000;
      for (let i = 0; i < batch.length; i += BATCH_SIZE) {
        const chunk = batch.slice(i, i + BATCH_SIZE);
        const ids = await db.transactions.bulkAdd(chunk, { allKeys: true });
        successCount += chunk.length;
      }

      setImportResult({ success: successCount, errors: errorCount });
      setStep(4);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('[Import] FATAL:', err);
      setImportResult({ success: successCount, errors: errorCount + 1, fatalError: err.message || String(err) });
      setStep(4);
    } finally {
      setIsImporting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleClose = () => {
    if (importResult) {
      if (onImportComplete) onImportComplete();
    }
    onClose();
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/50 z-[60] flex items-end sm:items-center justify-center p-0 sm:p-4">
      <div className="bg-white w-full max-w-3xl rounded-t-2xl sm:rounded-2xl p-4 sm:p-5 max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto overflow-x-hidden flex flex-col">

        <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-4 flex-shrink-0">
          <h2 className="text-lg font-bold">Import Historical Data</h2>
          <button onClick={handleClose} className="text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600 p-1">
            <X size={24} />
          </button>
        </div>

        {step === 1 && (
          <div className="text-center space-y-4 py-4">
            <div className="border-2 border-dashed border-blue-300 rounded-xl p-8 bg-blue-50">
              <Upload size={48} className="mx-auto text-blue-500 mb-3" />
              <p className="text-sm text-gray-600 mb-4">Select your .xlsx or .csv file</p>
              <input type="file" accept=".xlsx, .xls, .csv" onChange={handleFileUpload} className="hidden" id="excel-upload" />
              <label htmlFor="excel-upload" className="inline-block bg-blue-600 text-white px-6 py-3 rounded-lg font-bold cursor-pointer hover:bg-blue-700">
                Browse File
              </label>
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs text-gray-400">
              Imported data is marked as <strong>historical</strong> and will not affect current Zakat or Bucket calculations.
            </p>
          </div>
        )}

        {step === 1.5 && (
          <div className="space-y-4 py-4">
            <p className="text-sm text-gray-600">This file has multiple sheets. Pick one:</p>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
              {sheets.map(sheet => (
                <button key={sheet} onClick={() => handleSheetSelect(sheet)} className="p-3 bg-gray-50 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 hover:bg-blue-50 hover:border-blue-300 text-sm font-semibold">
                  {sheet}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {step === 2 && rows.length > 0 && (
          <div className="space-y-4 flex-1 overflow-y-auto">
            <div className="bg-blue-50 p-3 rounded-lg text-xs text-blue-700 flex-shrink-0">
              Sheet: <strong>{selectedSheet}</strong> • {rows.length} rows found
            </div>

            <p className="text-sm text-gray-600">Map your columns to our database fields:</p>

            <div className="space-y-3">
              {DB_FIELDS.map(field => {
                const currentIndex = mapping[field.key];
                const currentLabel = currentIndex !== undefined
                  ? (headers[currentIndex] || `Column ${currentIndex + 1}`)
                  : '-- Skip --';

                return (
                  <div key={field.key} className="flex flex-col gap-2 bg-gray-50 p-3 rounded-lg">
                    <div className="min-w-0">
                      <div className="font-semibold text-sm text-gray-700">
                        {field.label}
                        {field.required && <span className="text-red-500 ml-1">*</span>}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <CustomSelect
                      value={currentLabel}
                      onChange={(label) => handleMapChange(field.key, label)}
                      options={columnOptions}
                      searchable={columnOptions.length > 8}
                      required={false}
                    />
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>

            <div className="flex gap-2 pt-4 border-t border-gray-100 flex-shrink-0">
              <button onClick={() => { setStep(1); setRows([]); setHeaders([]); setFile(null); }} className="flex-1 bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 py-3 rounded-lg font-bold">
                Back
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={handleImport}
                disabled={isImporting || mapping.date === undefined || mapping.category === undefined || mapping.amount_original === undefined}
                className="flex-1 bg-blue-600 text-white py-3 rounded-lg font-bold disabled:opacity-50"
              >
                {isImporting ? 'Importing...' : `Import ${rows.length} Rows`}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {step === 4 && importResult && (
          <div className="text-center space-y-4 py-8">
            {importResult.fatalError ? (
              <>
                <AlertCircle size={48} className="mx-auto text-red-500" />
                <p className="text-lg font-bold text-red-600">Import Failed</p>
                <p className="text-sm text-gray-600">{importResult.fatalError}</p>
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                <CheckCircle size={48} className="mx-auto text-green-500" />
                <p className="text-lg font-bold text-green-600">Import Complete</p>
                <div className="text-sm text-gray-600">
                  <p><strong>{importResult.success}</strong> rows imported successfully.</p>
                  {importResult.errors > 0 && (
                    <p className="text-red-500 mt-1"><strong>{importResult.errors}</strong> rows skipped due to invalid data.</p>
                  )}
                </div>
              </>
            )}
            <button onClick={handleClose} className="mt-4 bg-blue-600 text-white px-8 py-3 rounded-lg font-bold hover:bg-blue-700">
              Done
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useMemo } from 'react';
import { useStore } from '../store/useStore';
import { TrendingUp, TrendingDown, Minus, Flame, Calendar, CheckCircle, AlertTriangle } from 'lucide-react';
import { formatMoney } from '../utils/format';

const MONTH_NAMES = ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec'];

function shiftMonth(monthString, delta) {
  const [y, m] = monthString.split('-').map(Number);
  const d = new Date(y, m - 1 + delta, 1);
  return `${d.getFullYear()}-${String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`;
}

function monthLabel(monthString) {
  const [y, m] = monthString.split('-').map(Number);
  return `${MONTH_NAMES[m - 1]} ${y}`;
}

function shortMonthLabel(monthString) {
  const [, m] = monthString.split('-').map(Number);
  return MONTH_NAMES[m - 1];
}

function StatRow({ label, current, previous, tone }) {
  const delta = current - previous;
  const pct = previous !== 0 ? (delta / Math.abs(previous)) * 100 : null;
  const isUp = delta > 0;
  const isFlat = Math.abs(delta) < 0.005;

  const toneColor = tone === 'income' ? 'text-green-600' : tone === 'expense' ? 'text-red-600' : 'text-gray-800';

  let DeltaIcon = Minus;
  let deltaColor = 'text-gray-400';
  if (!isFlat) {
    if (tone === 'income') {
      DeltaIcon = isUp ? TrendingUp : TrendingDown;
      deltaColor = isUp ? 'text-green-600' : 'text-red-500';
    } else if (tone === 'expense') {
      DeltaIcon = isUp ? TrendingUp : TrendingDown;
      deltaColor = isUp ? 'text-red-500' : 'text-green-600';
    } else {
      DeltaIcon = isUp ? TrendingUp : TrendingDown;
      deltaColor = isUp ? 'text-green-600' : 'text-red-500';
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex justify-between items-center py-2 border-b border-gray-100 last:border-0">
      <span className="text-sm text-gray-600 font-semibold">{label}</span>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
        <span className={`text-sm font-bold ${toneColor}`}>{formatMoney(current)}</span>
        <div className={`flex items-center gap-0.5 text-xs font-semibold ${deltaColor} min-w-[72px] justify-end`}>
          <DeltaIcon size={12} />
          {isFlat ? (
            <span>—</span>
          ) : (
            <span>
              {pct !== null ? `${pct >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${pct.toFixed(0)}%` : formatMoney(delta)}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function SectionCard({ title, icon: Icon, children, tone = 'default' }) {
  const borderTone =
    tone === 'warning' ? 'border-orange-400' :
    tone === 'success' ? 'border-green-500' :
    tone === 'info' ? 'border-blue-500' :
    'border-gray-200';

  return (
    <div className={`bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm border-l-4 ${borderTone} p-4 mb-4`}>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-3">
        {Icon && <Icon size={16} className="text-gray-500 flex-shrink-0" />}
        <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-gray-700 uppercase tracking-wide">{title}</h3>
      </div>
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}

export function InsightsTab({ selectedMonth }) {
  const { transactions, settings, calculateZakat } = useStore();

  const liveTx = useMemo(
    () => transactions.filter(t => !t.is_historical),
    [transactions]
  );

  const thisMonth = selectedMonth;
  const lastMonth = shiftMonth(selectedMonth, -1);
  const threeMonthsAgo = shiftMonth(selectedMonth, -2);

  const monthAgg = useMemo(() => {
    const build = (monthStr) => {
      const rows = liveTx.filter(t => t.date.startsWith(monthStr));
      const income = rows
        .filter(t => t.type === 'Income')
        .reduce((s, t) => s + t.amount_mvr, 0);
      const expense = rows
        .filter(t => t.type === 'Expense')
        .reduce((s, t) => s + t.amount_mvr, 0);
      return { income, expense, net: income - expense, count: rows.length };
    };
    return {
      this: build(thisMonth),
      last: build(lastMonth),
    };
  }, [liveTx, thisMonth, lastMonth]);

  const topSubs = useMemo(() => {
    const map = {};
    liveTx
      .filter(t => t.date.startsWith(thisMonth) && t.type === 'Expense')
      .forEach(t => {
        const key = `${t.category} › ${t.subcategory || '(none)'}`;
        if (!map[key]) map[key] = { key, category: t.category, subcategory: t.subcategory || '(none)', total: 0, count: 0 };
        map[key].total += t.amount_mvr;
        map[key].count += 1;
      });
    const arr = Object.values(map).sort((a, b) => b.total - a.total).slice(0, 5);
    const grand = arr.reduce((s, r) => s + r.total, 0);
    return { rows: arr, grand };
  }, [liveTx, thisMonth]);

  const trend = useMemo(() => {
    const months = [threeMonthsAgo, lastMonth, thisMonth];
    return months.map(m => {
      const rows = liveTx.filter(t => t.date.startsWith(m));
      const income = rows.filter(t => t.type === 'Income').reduce((s, t) => s + t.amount_mvr, 0);
      const expense = rows.filter(t => t.type === 'Expense').reduce((s, t) => s + t.amount_mvr, 0);
      return { month: m, income, expense };
    });
  }, [liveTx, threeMonthsAgo, lastMonth, thisMonth]);

  const trendMax = Math.max(
    1,
    ...trend.map(t => Math.max(t.income, t.expense))
  );

  const zakatYTD = useMemo(() => {
    const year = thisMonth.slice(0, 4);
    let totalDue = 0;
    let totalPaid = 0;
    let eligibleMonths = 0;
    for (let i = 1; i <= 12; i++) {
      const m = `${year}-${String(i).padStart(2, '0')}`;
      const z = calculateZakat(m);
      if (z.eligible) {
        eligibleMonths += 1;
        totalDue += z.baseZakat;
        totalPaid += z.zakatPaidThisMonth;
      }
    }
    return { totalDue, totalPaid, outstanding: Math.max(0, totalDue - totalPaid), eligibleMonths };
  }, [thisMonth, calculateZakat]);

  const bucketPulse = useMemo(() => {
    const rows = liveTx.filter(t => t.date.startsWith(thisMonth) && !t.is_historical);
    const income = rows.filter(t => t.type === 'Income').reduce((s, t) => s + t.amount_mvr, 0);

    const alloc = {
      Essential: income * ((settings.essential_pct || 0) / 100),
      Discretionary: income * ((settings.discretionary_pct || 0) / 100),
      Financial: income * ((settings.financial_pct || 0) / 100),
      Savings: income * ((settings.savings_pct || 0) / 100),
    };
    const spent = {
      Essential: rows.filter(t => t.type === 'Expense' && t.bucket === 'Essential').reduce((s, t) => s + t.amount_mvr, 0),
      Discretionary: rows.filter(t => t.type === 'Expense' && t.bucket === 'Discretionary').reduce((s, t) => s + t.amount_mvr, 0),
      Financial: rows.filter(t => t.type === 'Expense' && t.bucket === 'Financial/Obligatory').reduce((s, t) => s + t.amount_mvr, 0),
      Savings: 0,
    };
    const build = (name) => {
      const a = alloc[name];
      const sp = spent[name];
      const pct = a > 0 ? (sp / a) * 100 : 0;
      return { name, allocated: a, spent: sp, pct, over: sp > a && a > 0 };
    };
    return [build('Essential'), build('Discretionary'), build('Financial'), build('Savings')];
  }, [liveTx, thisMonth, settings]);

  const hasAnyData = monthAgg.this.count > 0 || monthAgg.last.count > 0;

  if (!hasAnyData) {
    return (
      <div className="text-center p-10 text-gray-400 bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm text-sm">
        No live transaction data yet for {monthLabel(thisMonth)} or {monthLabel(lastMonth)}.
        Add transactions or switch months to see insights.
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-1">
      <SectionCard title={`Month vs Month`} icon={Calendar} tone="info">
        <div className="text-xs text-gray-400 mb-2">
          {monthLabel(lastMonth)} → {monthLabel(thisMonth)}
        </div>
        <StatRow
          label="Income"
          current={monthAgg.this.income}
          previous={monthAgg.last.income}
          tone="income"
        />
        <StatRow
          label="Expenses"
          current={monthAgg.this.expense}
          previous={monthAgg.last.expense}
          tone="expense"
        />
        <StatRow
          label="Net"
          current={monthAgg.this.net}
          previous={monthAgg.last.net}
          tone="net"
        />
        <div className="text-[11px] text-gray-400 mt-2">
          This month: {monthAgg.this.count} txn • Last month: {monthAgg.last.count} txn
        </div>
      </SectionCard>

      <SectionCard title={`Top Subcategories — ${monthLabel(thisMonth)}`} icon={Flame} tone="warning">
        {topSubs.rows.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="text-xs text-gray-400 py-2">No expenses logged this month.</div>
        ) : (
          <div className="space-y-2">
            {topSubs.rows.map((r, i) => {
              const pct = topSubs.grand > 0 ? (r.total / topSubs.grand) * 100 : 0;
              return (
                <div key={r.key} className="relative">
                  <div
                    className="absolute top-0 left-0 h-full bg-orange-50 rounded-md"
                    style={{ width: `${pct}%` }}
                  ></div>
                  <div className="relative flex justify-between items-center gap-2 py-1.5">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 min-w-0">
                      <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-gray-400 w-4 flex-shrink-0">
                        #{i + 1}
                      </span>
                      <div className="min-w-0">
                        <div className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-700 truncate">
                          {r.subcategory}
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-[10px] text-gray-400 truncate">
                          {r.category} • {r.count} txn
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-right flex-shrink-0">
                      <div className="text-sm font-bold text-gray-800">{formatMoney(r.total)}</div>
                      <div className="text-[10px] text-gray-400">{pct.toFixed(1)}%</div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        )}
      </SectionCard>

      <SectionCard title="3-Month Trend" icon={TrendingUp} tone="info">
        <div className="flex items-end justify-between gap-2 h-40 pt-2">
          {trend.map(t => {
            const incH = (t.income / trendMax) * 100;
            const expH = (t.expense / trendMax) * 100;
            const isCurrent = t.month === thisMonth;
            return (
              <div key={t.month} className="flex-1 flex flex-col items-center gap-1 min-w-0">
                <div className="flex items-end gap-0.5 h-32 w-full justify-center">
                  <div
                    className={`w-1/2 max-w-[24px] rounded-t transition-all ${
                      isCurrent ? 'bg-green-500' : 'bg-green-300'
                    }`}
                    style={{ height: `${Math.max(2, incH)}%` }}
                    title={`Income ${formatMoney(t.income)}`}
                  ></div>
                  <div
                    className={`w-1/2 max-w-[24px] rounded-t transition-all ${
                      isCurrent ? 'bg-red-500' : 'bg-red-300'
                    }`}
                    style={{ height: `${Math.max(2, expH)}%` }}
                    title={`Expense ${formatMoney(t.expense)}`}
                  ></div>
                </div>
                <div className={`text-[11px] font-semibold ${isCurrent ? 'text-gray-800' : 'text-gray-500'}`}>
                  {shortMonthLabel(t.month)}
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
        <div className="flex justify-center gap-4 mt-3 text-[10px] text-gray-500">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
            <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-sm bg-green-500"></span> Income
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
            <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-sm bg-red-500"></span> Expense
          </div>
        </div>
      </SectionCard>

      <SectionCard
        title={`Zakat YTD — ${thisMonth.slice(0, 4)}`}
        icon={CheckCircle}
        tone={zakatYTD.outstanding > 0 ? 'warning' : 'success'}
      >
        <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 text-center">
          <div>
            <div className="text-[10px] font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase">Due</div>
            <div className="text-sm font-bold text-gray-800 truncate">
              {formatMoney(zakatYTD.totalDue)}
            </div>
          </div>
          <div>
            <div className="text-[10px] font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase">Paid</div>
            <div className="text-sm font-bold text-green-600 truncate">
              {formatMoney(zakatYTD.totalPaid)}
            </div>
          </div>
          <div>
            <div className="text-[10px] font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase">Outstanding</div>
            <div className={`text-sm font-bold truncate ${
              zakatYTD.outstanding > 0 ? 'text-orange-600' : 'text-green-600'
            }`}>
              {formatMoney(zakatYTD.outstanding)}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="text-[11px] text-gray-400 mt-3 text-center">
          Eligible months this year: {zakatYTD.eligibleMonths} / 12
        </div>
      </SectionCard>

      <SectionCard title={`Budget Pulse — ${monthLabel(thisMonth)}`} icon={AlertTriangle}>
        <div className="space-y-3">
          {bucketPulse.map(b => {
            const pctCapped = Math.min(100, b.pct);
            const barColor = b.allocated === 0
              ? 'bg-gray-300'
              : b.over
                ? 'bg-red-500'
                : b.pct > 80
                  ? 'bg-orange-400'
                  : 'bg-green-500';
            return (
              <div key={b.name}>
                <div className="flex justify-between items-baseline mb-1 gap-2">
                  <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-600 truncate">{b.name}</span>
                  <span className={`text-xs font-bold flex-shrink-0 ${
                    b.over ? 'text-red-600' : 'text-gray-700'
                  }`}>
                    {formatMoney(b.spent)}
                    <span className="text-gray-400 font-normal"> / {formatMoney(b.allocated)}</span>
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="w-full bg-gray-100 rounded-full h-2 overflow-hidden">
                  <div
                    className={`h-full transition-all ${barColor}`}
                    style={{ width: `${pctCapped}%` }}
                  ></div>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between text-[10px] text-gray-400 mt-0.5">
                  <span>{b.pct.toFixed(0)}% used</span>
                  {b.over && <span className="text-red-500 font-semibold">OVER BUDGET</span>}
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
        {monthAgg.this.income === 0 && (
          <div className="text-[11px] text-gray-400 mt-3 text-center">
            No income logged this month — allocations show as RF 0.00.
          </div>
        )}
      </SectionCard>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useState } from 'react';
import { DatePicker } from './DatePicker';

export function LoanForm({ initialData, onCancel, onSave }) {
  const [name, setName] = useState(initialData?.name || '');
  const [totalAmount, setTotalAmount] = useState(initialData?.total_amount || '');
  const [startDate, setStartDate] = useState(
    initialData?.start_date || new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)
  );
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState(initialData?.notes || '');

  const handleSubmit = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!name || !totalAmount) return;
    onSave({
      name,
      total_amount: parseFloat(totalAmount),
      start_date: startDate,
      notes
    });
  };

  return (
    <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
      <h3 className="font-bold text-gray-700">{initialData ? 'Edit Loan' : 'New Loan'}</h3>

      <div>
        <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 mb-1 block">Loan Name</label>
        <input 
          type="text"
          required
          value={name}
          onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)}
          className="w-full p-3 bg-gray-50 rounded-lg border border-gray-200"
          placeholder="e.g., Bank Loan - BML"
        />
      </div>

      <div>
        <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 mb-1 block">Total Amount (MVR)</label>
        <input 
          type="number"
          step="0.01"
          required
          value={totalAmount}
          onChange={(e) => setTotalAmount(e.target.value)}
          className="w-full p-3 bg-gray-50 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 text-lg font-bold"
          placeholder="0.00"
        />
      </div>

      <div>
        <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 mb-1 block">Start Date</label>
        <DatePicker value={startDate} onChange={setStartDate} />
      </div>

      <div>
        <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 mb-1 block">Notes (Optional)</label>
        <input 
          type="text"
          value={notes}
          onChange={(e) => setNotes(e.target.value)}
          className="w-full p-3 bg-gray-50 rounded-lg border border-gray-200"
          placeholder="Anything to remember"
        />
      </div>

      <div className="flex gap-2">
        <button 
          type="button"
          onClick={onCancel}
          className="flex-1 bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 py-3 rounded-lg font-bold hover:bg-gray-200 transition"
        >
          Cancel
        </button>
        <button 
          type="submit"
          className="flex-1 bg-blue-600 text-white py-3 rounded-lg font-bold hover:bg-blue-700 transition"
        >
          {initialData ? 'Save Changes' : 'Add Loan'}
        </button>
      </div>
    </form>
  );
}
