import { useState } from 'react';
import { X, Plus, Pencil, Trash2, CreditCard } from 'lucide-react';
import { LoanForm } from './LoanForm';
import { formatMoney } from '../utils/format';

export function LoansModal({ onClose, loans, getLoanPaid, addLoan, updateLoan, deleteLoan }) {
  const [isAdding, setIsAdding] = useState(false);
  const [editingLoan, setEditingLoan] = useState(null);

  const handleDelete = async (loan) => {
    const paid = getLoanPaid(loan.uuid);
    const confirmMsg =
      paid > 0
        ? `This loan has RF ${formatMoney(paid)} in recorded payments. Deleting will unlink those transactions but keep them as expenses. Continue?`
        : `Delete loan "${loan.name}"?`;
    if (window.confirm(confirmMsg)) {
      await deleteLoan(loan.id);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/50 z-50 flex items-end sm:items-center justify-center p-0 sm:p-4">
      <div className="bg-white w-full max-w-2xl rounded-t-2xl sm:rounded-2xl p-4 sm:p-5 max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto overflow-x-hidden">
        <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-4">
          <h2 className="text-lg font-bold flex items-center gap-2">
            <CreditCard size={20} className="text-red-500" /> Loans
          </h2>
          <button onClick={onClose} className="text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600">
            <X size={24} />
          </button>
        </div>

        {!isAdding && !editingLoan && (
          <>
            <button
              onClick={() => setIsAdding(true)}
              className="w-full mb-4 bg-blue-600 text-white py-3 rounded-lg font-bold hover:bg-blue-700 transition flex items-center justify-center gap-2"
            >
              <Plus size={18} /> Add Loan
            </button>

            {loans.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="text-center p-8 text-gray-400 bg-gray-50 rounded-xl text-sm">
                No loans yet. Add your first loan above.
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="space-y-3">
                {loans.map(loan => {
                  const paid = getLoanPaid(loan.uuid);
                  const remaining = Math.max(0, loan.total_amount - paid);
                  const pct = loan.total_amount > 0 ? (paid / loan.total_amount) * 100 : 0;
                  return (
                    <div key={loan.id} className="bg-gray-50 p-4 rounded-xl">
                      <div className="flex justify-between items-start mb-2 gap-2">
                        <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                          <div className="font-bold text-gray-800 truncate">{loan.name}</div>
                          {loan.start_date && (
                            <div className="text-xs text-gray-400">
                              Started {new Date(loan.start_date).toLocaleDateString()}
                            </div>
                          )}
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex gap-1 flex-shrink-0">
                          <button
                            onClick={() => setEditingLoan(loan)}
                            className="p-1.5 text-blue-500 hover:bg-blue-100 rounded"
                          >
                            <Pencil size={14} />
                          </button>
                          <button
                            onClick={() => handleDelete(loan)}
                            className="p-1.5 text-red-500 hover:bg-red-100 rounded"
                          >
                            <Trash2 size={14} />
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 text-xs mb-2">
                        <div>
                          <div className="text-gray-400">Total</div>
                          <div className="font-semibold text-gray-700">
                            RF {formatMoney(loan.total_amount)}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <div className="text-gray-400">Paid</div>
                          <div className="font-semibold text-green-600">RF {formatMoney(paid)}</div>
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <div className="text-gray-400">Remaining</div>
                          <div className="font-semibold text-red-600">
                            RF {formatMoney(remaining)}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      <div className="w-full bg-gray-200 rounded-full h-2 overflow-hidden">
                        <div
                          className="bg-green-500 h-full transition-all"
                          style={{ width: `${Math.min(100, pct)}%` }}
                        ></div>
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-[10px] text-gray-400 mt-1 text-right">
                        {pct.toFixed(1)}% paid
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            )}
          </>
        )}

        {(isAdding || editingLoan) && (
          <LoanForm
            initialData={editingLoan}
            onCancel={() => {
              setIsAdding(false);
              setEditingLoan(null);
            }}
            onSave={async (data) => {
              if (editingLoan) {
                await updateLoan(editingLoan.id, data);
              } else {
                await addLoan(data);
              }
              setIsAdding(false);
              setEditingLoan(null);
            }}
          />
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useState, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
import { ChevronDown } from 'lucide-react';
import { useClickOutside } from '../hooks/useClickOutside';

const MONTH_NAMES = ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec'];

export function MonthPicker({ selectedMonth, onChange }) {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [pickerYear, setPickerYear] = useState(parseInt(selectedMonth.slice(0, 4)));
  const ref = useRef(null);
  useClickOutside(ref, () => setIsOpen(false));

  useEffect(() => {
    setPickerYear(parseInt(selectedMonth.slice(0, 4)));
  }, [selectedMonth]);

  return (
    <div ref={ref} className="relative w-full">
      <button 
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setIsOpen(!isOpen)}
        className="w-full text-sm bg-gray-100 p-2 rounded-lg border-none outline-none text-left flex justify-between items-center"
      >
        <span>
          {MONTH_NAMES[parseInt(selectedMonth.slice(5, 7)) - 1]} {selectedMonth.slice(0, 4)}
        </span>
        <ChevronDown size={16} className={`text-gray-500 transition-transform ${isOpen ? 'rotate-180' : ''}`} />
      </button>
      
      {isOpen && (
        <div className="absolute z-50 mt-1 w-full bg-white rounded-lg shadow-lg border border-gray-200 p-3">
          <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-3">
            <button 
              type="button" 
              onClick={() => setPickerYear(y => y - 1)} 
              className="p-1 text-gray-500 hover:bg-gray-100 rounded w-8 h-8 flex items-center justify-center"
            >
              ←
            </button>
            <span className="font-bold text-sm">{pickerYear}</span>
            <button 
              type="button" 
              onClick={() => setPickerYear(y => y + 1)} 
              className="p-1 text-gray-500 hover:bg-gray-100 rounded w-8 h-8 flex items-center justify-center"
            >
              →
            </button>
          </div>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-1">
            {MONTH_NAMES.map((m, i) => {
              const monthVal = `${pickerYear}-${String(i + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`;
              const isSelected = selectedMonth === monthVal;
              return (
                <button
                  key={i}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => { onChange(monthVal); setIsOpen(false); }}
                  className={`p-2 text-sm rounded ${
                    isSelected 
                      ? 'bg-blue-500 text-white' 
                      : 'hover:bg-gray-100 text-gray-700'
                  }`}
                >
                  {m}
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { ChevronDown, ChevronRight } from 'lucide-react';
import { useStore } from '../store/useStore';
import { DatePicker } from './DatePicker';
import { CustomSelect } from './CustomSelect';
import { formatMoney } from '../utils/format';

const TYPE_OPTIONS = ['All', 'Expense', 'Income'];

function firstOfCurrentMonth() {
  const d = new Date();
  return `${d.getFullYear()}-${String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-01`;
}

function todayISO() {
  const d = new Date();
  return `${d.getFullYear()}-${String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')}`;
}

function CategoryBlock({ title, tone, data }) {
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState({});
  const { categories, grandTotal } = data;

  if (categories.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="text-center p-6 text-gray-400 bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm text-sm">
        No {title.toLowerCase()} in this range.
      </div>
    );
  }

  const toneText = tone === 'income' ? 'text-green-700' : 'text-gray-800';
  const toneBg = tone === 'income' ? 'bg-green-50' : 'bg-blue-50';

  return (
    <div className="space-y-2">
      <div className="flex justify-between items-baseline">
        <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-gray-700 uppercase tracking-wide">{title}</h3>
        <span className={`text-base font-bold ${toneText}`}>
          RF {formatMoney(grandTotal)}
        </span>
      </div>

      {categories.map(c => {
        const pct = grandTotal > 0 ? (c.total / grandTotal) * 100 : 0;
        const isOpen = !!expanded[c.category];
        return (
          <div key={c.category} className="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm overflow-hidden">
            <button
              onClick={() => setExpanded(e => ({ ...e, [c.category]: !e[c.category] }))}
              className="w-full flex justify-between items-center gap-2 p-3 hover:bg-gray-50"
            >
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 min-w-0">
                {isOpen
                  ? <ChevronDown size={16} className="text-gray-400 flex-shrink-0" />
                  : <ChevronRight size={16} className="text-gray-400 flex-shrink-0" />
                }
                <span className="font-semibold text-gray-700 truncate">{c.category}</span>
                <span className={`text-[10px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full font-semibold flex-shrink-0 ${toneBg} ${toneText}`}>
                  {pct.toFixed(1)}%
                </span>
              </div>
              <span className={`font-bold flex-shrink-0 ${toneText}`}>
                RF {formatMoney(c.total)}
              </span>
            </button>

            {isOpen && (
              <div className="border-t border-gray-100">
                {c.subcategories.map(s => {
                  const subPct = c.total > 0 ? (s.total / c.total) * 100 : 0;
                  return (
                    <div key={s.subcategory} className="flex justify-between items-center px-4 py-2 bg-gray-50/40">
                      <div className="min-w-0">
                        <div className="text-sm text-gray-700 truncate">{s.subcategory}</div>
                        <div className="text-[10px] text-gray-400">
                          {s.count} txn • {subPct.toFixed(1)}% of {c.category}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <div className={`text-sm font-semibold flex-shrink-0 ${toneText}`}>
                        RF {formatMoney(s.total)}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}

export function RangeReport({ allCategories }) {
  const { getTransactionsInRange, aggregateRange } = useStore();

  const [from, setFrom] = useState(firstOfCurrentMonth());
  const [to, setTo] = useState(todayISO());
  const [type, setType] = useState('All');
  const [category, setCategory] = useState('');
  const [includeHistorical, setIncludeHistorical] = useState(true);

  const rows = useMemo(() => {
    return getTransactionsInRange(from, to, {
      includeHistorical,
      type,
      category: category || null,
    });
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [from, to, type, category, includeHistorical]);

  const { expenses, incomes } = useMemo(() => aggregateRange(rows), [rows, aggregateRange]);

  const historicalCount = rows.filter(r => r.is_historical).length;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-800">Range Report</h2>

      <div className="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm p-3 space-y-3">
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
          <div className="min-w-0">
            <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 mb-1 block">From</label>
            <DatePicker value={from} onChange={setFrom} />
          </div>
          <div className="min-w-0">
            <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 mb-1 block">To</label>
            <DatePicker value={to} onChange={setTo} />
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
          <div className="min-w-0">
            <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 mb-1 block">Type</label>
            <CustomSelect
              value={type}
              onChange={setType}
              options={TYPE_OPTIONS}
              searchable={false}
              required={true}
            />
          </div>
          <div className="min-w-0">
            <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 mb-1 block">Category (optional)</label>
            <CustomSelect
              value={category}
              onChange={setCategory}
              options={['', ...allCategories]}
              placeholder="All categories"
              required={false}
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-gray-600 select-none">
          <input
            type="checkbox"
            checked={includeHistorical}
            onChange={(e) => setIncludeHistorical(e.target.checked)}
            className="accent-blue-600"
          />
          Include historical data
          {historicalCount > 0 && (
            <span className="bg-gray-100 text-gray-600 text-[10px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full font-semibold">
              {historicalCount} historical row{historicalCount === 1 ? '' : 's'}
            </span>
          )}
        </label>
      </div>

      <div className="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm p-4">
        <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 text-center">
          <div>
            <div className="text-[10px] font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase">Expense</div>
            <div className="text-base font-bold text-gray-800">
              RF {formatMoney(expenses.grandTotal)}
            </div>
          </div>
          <div>
            <div className="text-[10px] font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase">Income</div>
            <div className="text-base font-bold text-green-600">
              RF {formatMoney(incomes.grandTotal)}
            </div>
          </div>
          <div>
            <div className="text-[10px] font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase">Net</div>
            <div className={`text-base font-bold ${
              incomes.grandTotal - expenses.grandTotal >= 0 ? 'text-green-600' : 'text-red-600'
            }`}>
              RF {formatMoney(incomes.grandTotal - expenses.grandTotal)}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="text-[11px] text-gray-400 mt-2 text-center">
          {rows.length} transactions in range
        </div>
      </div>

      {(type === 'All' || type === 'Expense') && (
        <CategoryBlock title="Expenses" tone="expense" data={expenses} />
      )}

      {(type === 'All' || type === 'Income') && (
        <CategoryBlock title="Incomes" tone="income" data={incomes} />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import { useState } from 'react';
import { ArrowDownCircle, ArrowUpCircle, Trash2, Pencil } from 'lucide-react';
import { formatMoney } from '../utils/format';

export function RecentTransactions({ transactions, onEdit, onDelete }) {
  const [showHistorical, setShowHistorical] = useState(false);

  const filtered = showHistorical
    ? transactions
    : transactions.filter(t => !t.is_historical);

  return (
    <div className="mb-6">
      <div className="flex justify-between items-baseline mb-3 gap-2">
        <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-800">Recent Transactions</h2>
        <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-gray-600 select-none">
          <input
            type="checkbox"
            checked={showHistorical}
            onChange={(e) => setShowHistorical(e.target.checked)}
            className="accent-blue-600"
          />
          Show historical
        </label>
      </div>

      {filtered.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="text-center p-6 text-gray-400 bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm text-sm">
          No transactions yet.
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-2">
          {filtered.map(t => (
            <div
              key={t.id}
              className={`bg-white p-3 rounded-xl shadow-sm flex justify-between items-center gap-2 ${
                t.is_historical ? 'opacity-70 border border-dashed border-gray-300' : ''
              }`}
            >
              <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                  {t.type === 'Income'
                    ? <ArrowUpCircle size={16} className="text-green-600 flex-shrink-0" />
                    : <ArrowDownCircle size={16} className="text-red-500 flex-shrink-0" />
                  }
                  <span className="font-semibold text-gray-700 text-sm truncate">
                    {t.subcategory || t.category}
                  </span>
                  {t.is_historical && (
                    <span className="text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full font-semibold flex-shrink-0 bg-gray-200 text-gray-600">
                      HISTORICAL
                    </span>
                  )}
                  {t.type === 'Expense' && t.bucket && (
                    <span className={`text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full font-semibold flex-shrink-0 ${
                      t.bucket === 'Essential' ? 'bg-green-100 text-green-700' :
                      t.bucket === 'Discretionary' ? 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-700' :
                      'bg-purple-100 text-purple-700'
                    }`}>
                      {t.bucket}
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>
                <div className="text-xs text-gray-400 mt-0.5 truncate">
                  {t.category} • {new Date(t.date).toLocaleDateString()}
                  {t.notes && ` • ${t.notes}`}
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="text-right flex-shrink-0">
                <div className={`font-bold text-sm ${t.type === 'Income' ? 'text-green-600' : 'text-gray-800'}`}>
                  {t.type === 'Income' ? '+' : '-'} RF {formatMoney(t.amount_mvr)}
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="flex gap-1 flex-shrink-0">
                <button
                  onClick={() => onEdit(t)}
                  disabled={t.is_historical}
                  className={`p-2 rounded-lg ${t.is_historical ? 'text-gray-300 cursor-not-allowed' : 'text-blue-500 hover:bg-blue-50'}`}
                  title={t.is_historical ? 'Historical rows are read-only' : 'Edit'}
                >
                  <Pencil size={16} />
                </button>
                <button
                  onClick={() => onDelete(t.id)}
                  className="p-2 text-red-500 hover:bg-red-50 rounded-lg"
                >
                  <Trash2 size={16} />
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import { useState } from 'react';
import { X, Search } from 'lucide-react';
import { BucketDropdown } from './BucketDropdown';

const MONTH_NAMES = ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec'];

export function SettingsModal({ onClose, settings, updateSetting, bucketMap, updateBucketFor, onDataChanged }) {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState('general');
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const [isImportOpen, setIsImportOpen] = useState(false);

  const [localRates, setLocalRates] = useState({
    current_usd_rate: settings.current_usd_rate || 15.42,
    nisab_threshold: settings.nisab_threshold || 10000,
    essential_pct: settings.essential_pct || 40,
    discretionary_pct: settings.discretionary_pct || 10,
    financial_pct: settings.financial_pct || 15,
    savings_pct: settings.savings_pct || 35,
  });

  const [zakatInputs, setZakatInputs] = useState({
    debt_receivable: settings.debt_receivable || 0,
    bank_balance_override: settings.bank_balance_override || '',
    prev_year_balances: settings.prev_year_balances || {},
  });

  const handleLocalChange = (key, value) => setLocalRates({ ...localRates, [key]: value });
  const handleZakatInputChange = (key, value) => setZakatInputs({ ...zakatInputs, [key]: value });

  const handlePrevMonthChange = (monthIdx, value) => {
    const key = String(monthIdx + 1).padStart(2, '0');
    setZakatInputs({
      ...zakatInputs,
      prev_year_balances: { ...zakatInputs.prev_year_balances, [key]: value }
    });
  };

  const saveGeneral = async () => {
    await updateSetting('current_usd_rate', parseFloat(localRates.current_usd_rate) || 15.42);
    await updateSetting('nisab_threshold', parseFloat(localRates.nisab_threshold) || 10000);
    await updateSetting('essential_pct', parseFloat(localRates.essential_pct) || 40);
    await updateSetting('discretionary_pct', parseFloat(localRates.discretionary_pct) || 10);
    await updateSetting('financial_pct', parseFloat(localRates.financial_pct) || 15);
    await updateSetting('savings_pct', parseFloat(localRates.savings_pct) || 35);
    alert('General settings saved!');
  };

  const saveZakatInputs = async () => {
    await updateSetting('debt_receivable', parseFloat(zakatInputs.debt_receivable) || 0);
    await updateSetting('bank_balance_override', zakatInputs.bank_balance_override);
    await updateSetting('prev_year_balances', zakatInputs.prev_year_balances);
    alert('Zakat inputs saved!');
  };

  const filteredMap = bucketMap.filter(row => 
    row.category.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||
    row.subcategory.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())
  );

  const totalPct = 
    (parseFloat(localRates.essential_pct) || 0) + 
    (parseFloat(localRates.discretionary_pct) || 0) + 
    (parseFloat(localRates.financial_pct) || 0) + 
    (parseFloat(localRates.savings_pct) || 0);

  return (
    <>
      <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/50 z-40 flex items-end sm:items-center justify-center p-0 sm:p-4">
        <div className="bg-white w-full max-w-2xl rounded-t-2xl sm:rounded-2xl p-4 sm:p-5 max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto overflow-x-hidden">
          
          <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-4">
            <h2 className="text-lg font-bold">Settings</h2>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <button 
                onClick={() => setIsImportOpen(true)}
                className="text-xs bg-blue-100 text-blue-700 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg font-semibold hover:bg-blue-200"
              >
                Import Data
              </button>
              <button onClick={onClose} className="text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600">
                <X size={24} />
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex gap-1 border-b mb-4 overflow-x-auto">
            <button onClick={() => setActiveTab('general')} className={`px-3 py-2 text-sm font-semibold whitespace-nowrap ${activeTab === 'general' ? 'text-blue-600 border-b-2 border-blue-600' : 'text-gray-500'}`}>General</button>
            <button onClick={() => setActiveTab('buckets')} className={`px-3 py-2 text-sm font-semibold whitespace-nowrap ${activeTab === 'buckets' ? 'text-blue-600 border-b-2 border-blue-600' : 'text-gray-500'}`}>Bucket Map</button>
            <button onClick={() => setActiveTab('zakat')} className={`px-3 py-2 text-sm font-semibold whitespace-nowrap ${activeTab === 'zakat' ? 'text-blue-600 border-b-2 border-blue-600' : 'text-gray-500'}`}>Zakat Inputs</button>
          </div>

          {activeTab === 'general' && (
            <div className="space-y-4">
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <div className="min-w-0">
                  <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 mb-1 block">USD → MVR Rate</label>
                  <input type="number" step="0.01" value={localRates.current_usd_rate} onChange={(e) => handleLocalChange('current_usd_rate', e.target.value)} className="w-full p-2 bg-gray-50 rounded-lg border border-gray-200" />
                </div>
                <div className="min-w-0">
                  <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 mb-1 block">Nisab (MVR)</label>
                  <input type="number" step="0.01" value={localRates.nisab_threshold} onChange={(e) => handleLocalChange('nisab_threshold', e.target.value)} className="w-full p-2 bg-gray-50 rounded-lg border border-gray-200" />
                </div>
              </div>
              
              <div>
                <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 mb-2 block">Bucket Allocations (%)</label>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                  <div className="min-w-0"><label className="text-xs text-gray-400">Essential</label><input type="number" value={localRates.essential_pct} onChange={(e) => handleLocalChange('essential_pct', e.target.value)} className="w-full p-2 bg-gray-50 rounded-lg border border-gray-200" /></div>

                  <div className="min-w-0"><label className="text-xs text-gray-400">Financial/Obligatory</label><input type="number" value={localRates.financial_pct} onChange={(e) => handleLocalChange('financial_pct', e.target.value)} className="w-full p-2 bg-gray-50 rounded-lg border border-gray-200" /></div>
                  <div className="min-w-0"><label className="text-xs text-gray-400">Savings</label><input type="number" value={localRates.savings_pct} onChange={(e) => handleLocalChange('savings_pct', e.target.value)} className="w-full p-2 bg-gray-50 rounded-lg border border-gray-200" /></div>
                </div>

                </div>

            </div>
          )}

        </div>
      </div>

      {isImportOpen && (
        <ImportModal 
          onClose={() => setIsImportOpen(false)} 
          onImportComplete={() => {
            if (onDataChanged) onDataChanged();
            // We no longer close the modal here. ImportModal closes itself when the user is ready.
          }}
        />
      )}
    </>
  );
}

import { Download, ChevronDown, ChevronRight } from 'lucide-react';

import { exportMasterSheet } from '../utils/exportExcel';

// Sub-component to render each table (Expenses or Incomes)
function SummaryTable({ title, tone, data, type }) {
  const { getSubcategoryYearlySummary } = useStore();
  const { years, rows, grandTotalByYear, grandTotal } = data;
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState({});

  if (years.length === 0) return null;

  const toggleExpand = (category) => {
    setExpanded(prev => ({ ...prev, [category]: !prev[category] }));
  };

  const isIncome = tone === 'income';
  const headerBg = isIncome ? 'bg-green-50' : 'bg-gray-50';
  const textColor = isIncome ? 'text-green-700' : 'text-gray-900';
  const borderCol = isIncome ? 'border-green-200' : 'border-gray-200';

  return (
    <div className="mb-8">

        {title}
      </h3>
      
      <div className={`bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm overflow-hidden border-l-4 ${isIncome ? 'border-green-500' : 'border-blue-500'}`}>
        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
          <table className="min-w-full text-sm">
            <thead className={headerBg}>
              <tr>
                {/* FIXED: Added explicit solid background and fixed width for the sticky column */}
                <th className="sticky left-0 bg-inherit text-left px-3 py-2 font-semibold text-gray-700 z-20 min-w-[140px] max-w-[140px] truncate shadow-[1px_0_0_0_#e5e7eb]">
                  Category
                </th>
                {years.map(y => (
                  <th key={y} className="px-3 py-2 font-semibold text-gray-700 text-right whitespace-nowrap min-w-[80px]">
                    {y}
                  </th>
                ))}
                <th className={`px-3 py-2 font-semibold text-right whitespace-nowrap ${textColor} bg-black/5`}>
                  Avg
                </th>
                <th className={`px-3 py-2 font-semibold text-right whitespace-nowrap ${textColor} bg-black/5`}>
                  Total
                </th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {rows.map(r => {
                const isOpen = !!expanded[r.category];
                const subcategories = isOpen ? getSubcategoryYearlySummary(r.category, years, type) : [];

                return (
                  <Fragment key={r.category}>
                    {/* --- Main Category Row --- */}
                    <tr 
                      onClick={() => toggleExpand(r.category)}
                      className="border-t border-gray-100 hover:bg-gray-50 cursor-pointer transition-colors"
                    >
                      {/* FIXED: Solid background and shadow for sticky column */}
                      <td className="sticky left-0 bg-white px-3 py-2 font-semibold text-gray-700 z-10 truncate max-w-[140px] shadow-[1px_0_0_0_#f3f4f6]">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                          {isOpen 
                            ? <ChevronDown size={14} className="text-gray-400 flex-shrink-0" /> 
                            : <ChevronRight size={14} className="text-gray-400 flex-shrink-0" />
                          }
                          <span className="truncate">{r.category}</span>
                        </div>
                      </td>
                      {years.map(y => (
                        <td key={y} className={`px-3 py-2 text-right whitespace-nowrap ${isIncome ? 'text-green-600' : 'text-gray-700'}`}>
                          {r.byYear[y] > 0 ? r.byYear[y].toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 }) : '—'}
                        </td>
                      ))}
                      <td className="px-3 py-2 text-right text-gray-500 whitespace-nowrap bg-black/5">
                        {r.avg.toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}
                      </td>
                      <td className={`px-3 py-2 text-right font-bold whitespace-nowrap bg-black/5 ${isIncome ? 'text-green-700' : 'text-gray-900'}`}>
                        {r.total.toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}
                      </td>
                    </tr>

                    {/* --- Subcategory Rows --- */}
                    {isOpen && subcategories.map(sub => (
                      <tr key={`${r.category}-${sub.subcategory}`} className="bg-gray-50/40 border-t border-gray-50">
                        {/* FIXED: Solid background for sticky column */}
                        <td className="sticky left-0 bg-[#fafafa] px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-gray-500 z-10 truncate max-w-[140px] pl-8 shadow-[1px_0_0_0_#f3f4f6]">
                          {sub.subcategory || '(No subcategory)'}
                        </td>
                        {years.map(y => (
                          <td key={y} className="px-3 py-1.5 text-right text-xs text-gray-500 whitespace-nowrap">
                            {sub.byYear[y] > 0 ? sub.byYear[y].toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 }) : '—'}
                          </td>
                        ))}
                        <td className="px-3 py-1.5 text-right text-xs text-gray-400 whitespace-nowrap bg-black/5">
                          {sub.avg.toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}
                        </td>
                        <td className={`px-3 py-1.5 text-right font-semibold text-xs whitespace-nowrap bg-black/5 ${isIncome ? 'text-green-600/70' : 'text-gray-600'}`}>
                          {sub.total.toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    ))}
                  </Fragment>
                );
              })}

              {/* --- Grand Total Row --- */}
              <tr className={`border-t-2 ${borderCol} bg-gray-50 font-bold`}>
                {/* FIXED: Solid background for sticky column */}
                <td className="sticky left-0 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2 text-gray-900 z-10 truncate max-w-[140px] shadow-[1px_0_0_0_#e5e7eb]">
                  All {title}
                </td>
                {years.map(y => (
                  <td key={y} className={`px-3 py-2 text-right whitespace-nowrap ${isIncome ? 'text-green-700' : 'text-gray-900'}`}>
                    {grandTotalByYear[y] > 0 ? grandTotalByYear[y].toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 }) : '—'}
                  </td>
                ))}
                <td className="px-3 py-2 text-right text-gray-500 whitespace-nowrap bg-black/5">
                  —
                </td>
                <td className={`px-3 py-2 text-right whitespace-nowrap bg-black/5 ${isIncome ? 'text-green-700' : 'text-gray-900'}`}>
                  {grandTotal.toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}
                </td>
              </tr>
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export function YearlySummary() {
  const { getYearlySummary } = useStore();
  
  const expenseData = useMemo(() => getYearlySummary('Expense'), [getYearlySummary]);
  const incomeData = useMemo(() => getYearlySummary('Income'), [getYearlySummary]);

  const hasExpenses = expenseData.years.length > 0;
  const hasIncome = incomeData.years.length > 0;

  if (!hasExpenses && !hasIncome) {
    return (
      <div className="text-center p-10 text-gray-400 bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm text-sm">
        No data yet. Add or import transactions to see the yearly summary.
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <div className="flex justify-between items-center gap-2">
        <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-800">Yearly Summary</h2>
        <button
          onClick={() => exportMasterSheet(expenseData, incomeData)}
          className="text-xs bg-blue-600 text-white px-3 py-2 rounded-lg font-semibold hover:bg-blue-700 flex items-center gap-1 flex-shrink-0"
        >
          <Download size={14} /> Export
        </button>
      </div>

      <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 -mt-2">
        Includes historical & live transactions. Tap a category to see subcategory breakdown.
      </p>

      {hasExpenses && (
        <SummaryTable 
          title="Expenses" 
          tone="expense" 
          data={expenseData} 
          type="Expense" 
        />
      )}

      {hasIncome && (
        <SummaryTable 
          title="Incomes" 
          tone="income" 
          data={incomeData} 
          type="Income" 
        />
      )}

      <p className="text-[11px] text-gray-400 text-center pb-4">
        Tip: swipe tables horizontally on mobile. The first column stays pinned.
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useState } from 'react';
import { AlertCircle, Check, ChevronDown } from 'lucide-react';
import { formatMoney } from '../utils/format';

const MONTH_NAMES = ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec'];

export function ZakatCard({ zakat, selectedMonth, onMarkPaid }) {
  const monthName = MONTH_NAMES[parseInt(selectedMonth.slice(5, 7)) - 1];
  const year = selectedMonth.slice(0, 4);

  const defaultExpanded = zakat.eligible && !zakat.fullyPaid;
  const [isExpanded, setIsExpanded] = useState(defaultExpanded);

  const stateClasses = !zakat.eligible 
    ? 'bg-gradient-to-r from-gray-400 to-gray-500' 
    : zakat.fullyPaid 
      ? 'bg-gradient-to-r from-green-600 to-green-500' 
      : 'bg-gradient-to-r from-orange-500 to-orange-400';

  const headline = !zakat.eligible 
    ? 'Ineligible' 
    : zakat.fullyPaid 
      ? `Paid ✓ (RF ${formatMoney(zakat.baseZakat)})` 
      : `RF ${formatMoney(zakat.zakatDue)}`;

  return (
    <div className={`rounded-xl shadow-md mb-6 text-white ${stateClasses}`}>
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setIsExpanded(!isExpanded)}
        className="w-full p-4 text-left"
      >
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1 gap-2">
          <div className="flex items-center min-w-0">
            <AlertCircle size={18} className="mr-2 flex-shrink-0" />
            <span className="text-sm font-semibold truncate">
              Zakat {monthName} {year}
            </span>
          </div>
          <ChevronDown 
            size={18} 
            className={`flex-shrink-0 transition-transform ${isExpanded ? 'rotate-180' : ''}`} 
          />
        </div>
        
        <div className="text-2xl font-bold truncate">{headline}</div>
      </button>

      {zakat.eligible && zakat.zakatDue > 0 && (
        <div className="px-4 pb-3 -mt-1 flex justify-end">
          <button 
            onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); onMarkPaid(); }}
            className="text-xs bg-white/20 hover:bg-white/30 px-3 py-1 rounded-full font-semibold flex items-center gap-1"
          >
            <Check size={12} /> Mark Paid
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {isExpanded && (
        <div className="px-4 pb-4 text-xs opacity-90 space-y-0.5">
          {!zakat.eligible ? (
            <div>
              Bank before Zakat (RF {formatMoney(zakat.bankBalanceBeforeZakat)}) does not exceed Nisab (RF {formatMoney(zakat.nisab)}) or last year's {monthName} balance (RF {formatMoney(zakat.lastYearBalance)})
            </div>
          ) : (
            <>
              <div>Bank: RF {formatMoney(zakat.bankBalanceBeforeZakat)} − Debt: RF {formatMoney(zakat.debtPayable)} + Receivable: RF {formatMoney(zakat.debtReceivable)}</div>
              <div>Zakatable: RF {formatMoney(zakat.zakatableAmount)} × 2.5% = <strong>RF {formatMoney(zakat.baseZakat)}</strong></div>
              {zakat.zakatPaidThisMonth > 0 && (
                <div>Paid this month: − RF {formatMoney(zakat.zakatPaidThisMonth)} {zakat.fullyPaid ? '(fully paid ✓)' : `(remaining: RF ${formatMoney(zakat.zakatDue)})`}</div>
              )}
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import { useState } from 'react';
import { X, CheckCircle } from 'lucide-react';

export function ZakatPaidModal({ onClose, onConfirm, suggestedAmount }) {
  const [amount, setAmount] = useState(suggestedAmount.toFixed(2));

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/50 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
      <div className="bg-white w-full max-w-sm rounded-2xl p-5">
        <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-4">
          <h2 className="text-lg font-bold flex items-center gap-2">
            <CheckCircle size={20} className="text-green-600" /> Mark Zakat Paid
          </h2>
          <button onClick={onClose} className="text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600">
            <X size={20} />
          </button>
        </div>

        <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mb-4">
          Records a transaction under <strong>Personal → Zakat</strong>. It reduces the Financial bucket and marks this month's Zakat as paid.
        </p>

        <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 mb-1 block">Amount Paid</label>
        <input 
          type="number" 
          step="0.01"
          value={amount}
          onChange={(e) => setAmount(e.target.value)}
          className="w-full p-3 bg-gray-50 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 mb-4 text-lg font-bold"
        />

        <button 
          onClick={() => onConfirm(parseFloat(amount))}
          className="w-full bg-green-600 text-white py-3 rounded-lg font-bold hover:bg-green-700 transition"
        >
          Confirm Payment
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import Dexie from 'dexie';
import { SEED_DATA } from './seedData';
import { v4 as uuidv4 } from 'uuid';

export const db = new Dexie('FinanceERP');

db.version(202).stores({
  transactions: '++id, uuid, date, category, subcategory, amount_original, currency, exchange_rate_at_time, amount_mvr, type, is_historical, notes, syncStatus, updated_at, deleted',
  settings: 'key, uuid, syncStatus, updated_at, deleted',
  loans: '++id, uuid, name, total_amount, start_date, notes, syncStatus, updated_at, deleted',
  loan_payments: '++id, loan_id, date, amount, transaction_id',
  zakat_log: '++id, month, total_savings, zakat_due, zakat_paid',
  exchange_rates: '++id, date_set, rate',
  bucket_map: '++id, uuid, category, subcategory, bucket, syncStatus, updated_at, deleted'
}).upgrade(async tx => {
  const addUuids = async (tableName) => {
    await tx.table(tableName).toCollection().modify(item => {
      if (!item.uuid) item.uuid = uuidv4();
      item.syncStatus = 'pending';
    });
  };
  await addUuids('transactions');
  await addUuids('loans');
  await addUuids('bucket_map');
  
  await tx.table('settings').toCollection().modify(item => {
    if (!item.uuid) item.uuid = uuidv4();
    item.syncStatus = 'pending';
  });
});

export const initSettings = async () => {
  const count = await db.settings.count();
  if (count === 0) {
    const defaults = [
      { key: 'essential_pct', value: 40 }, { key: 'discretionary_pct', value: 10 },
      { key: 'financial_pct', value: 15 }, { key: 'savings_pct', value: 35 },
      { key: 'nisab_threshold', value: 10000 }, { key: 'zakat_rate', value: 2.5 },
      { key: 'current_usd_rate', value: 15.42 }, { key: 'debt_receivable', value: 0 },
      { key: 'bank_balance_override', value: '' }, { key: 'prev_year_balances', value: {} }
    ];
    await db.settings.bulkPut(defaults.map(d => ({ 
      ...d, uuid: uuidv4(), syncStatus: 'pending', updated_at: new Date().toISOString(), deleted: false 
    })));
  }

  const mapCount = await db.bucket_map.count();
  if (mapCount === 0) {
    await db.bucket_map.bulkAdd(DEFAULT_BUCKET_MAP.map(b => ({ 
      ...b, uuid: uuidv4(), syncStatus: 'pending', updated_at: new Date().toISOString(), deleted: false 
    })));
  }

  const txCount = await db.transactions.count();
  if (txCount === 0 && SEED_DATA.length > 0) {
    await db.transactions.bulkAdd(SEED_DATA.map(t => ({ 
      ...t, uuid: uuidv4(), syncStatus: 'pending', updated_at: new Date().toISOString(), deleted: false 
    })));
  }
};

import { useEffect } from 'react';

export function useClickOutside(ref, onClose) {
  useEffect(() => {
    const handler = (e) => {
      if (ref.current && !ref.current.contains(e.target)) onClose();
    };
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handler);
    document.addEventListener('touchstart', handler);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handler);
      document.removeEventListener('touchstart', handler);
    };
  }, [ref, onClose]);
}

import { createClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';

const supabaseUrl = import.meta.env.VITE_SUPABASE_URL;
const supabaseAnonKey = import.meta.env.VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY;

if (!supabaseUrl || !supabaseAnonKey) {
  console.warn('Missing Supabase environment variables. Cloud sync will be disabled.');
}

import { supabase } from './supabaseClient';
import { db } from '../db/database';

const LAST_SYNC_KEY = 'finance_erp_last_sync';
const PAGE_SIZE = 1000;
const PUSH_CHUNK = 500;

export const getLastSync = () => localStorage.getItem(LAST_SYNC_KEY);
export const setLastSync = (isoString) => localStorage.setItem(LAST_SYNC_KEY, isoString);

async function fetchAllRows(table, userId, sinceISO) {
  const allRows = [];
  let from = 0;

  while (true) {
    let query = supabase
      .from(table)
      .select('*')
      .eq('user_id', userId)
      .order('updated_at', { ascending: true })
      .range(from, from + PAGE_SIZE - 1);

    if (sinceISO) {
      query = query.gt('updated_at', sinceISO);
    }

    const { data, error } = await query;
    if (error) throw error;

    if (!data || data.length === 0) break;
    allRows.push(...data);

    if (data.length < PAGE_SIZE) break;
    from += PAGE_SIZE;
  }

  return allRows;
}

export async function pushChanges() {
  const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
  if (!session) return false; // Return false to signal failure

  const tables = ['transactions', 'settings', 'loans', 'bucket_map'];
  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  let allSuccessful = true;

  for (const table of tables) {
    const pending = await db.table(table).where('syncStatus').equals('pending').toArray();
    if (pending.length === 0) continue;

    const toPush = pending.map(row => {
      // eslint-disable-next-line no-unused-vars
      const { id, syncStatus, uuid, ...rest } = row;
      return {
        id: uuid, 
        ...rest,
        user_id: session.user.id,
        updated_at: now,
      };
    });

    for (let i = 0; i < toPush.length; i += PUSH_CHUNK) {
      const chunk = toPush.slice(i, i + PUSH_CHUNK);
      const chunkPending = pending.slice(i, i + PUSH_CHUNK);

      try {
        if (table === 'settings') {
          const { error } = await supabase
            .from(table)
            .upsert(chunk, { onConflict: 'user_id,key' });
          if (error) throw error;
          const keys = chunkPending.map(p => p.key);
          await db.settings.where('key').anyOf(keys).modify({ syncStatus: 'synced' });
        } else {
          const { error } = await supabase.from(table).upsert(chunk);
          if (error) throw error;
          const uuids = chunkPending.map(p => p.uuid);
          await db.table(table).where('uuid').anyOf(uuids).modify({ syncStatus: 'synced' });
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error(`Error pushing ${table} chunk starting at ${i}:`, err.message);
        allSuccessful = false;
      }
    }
  }
  
  return allSuccessful;
}

export async function pullChanges(isFirstSync = false) {
  const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
  if (!session) return;

  const lastSync = getLastSync() || '1970-01-01T00:00:00.000Z';
  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  const tables = ['transactions', 'settings', 'loans', 'bucket_map'];

  const fetched = {};
  for (const table of tables) {
    try {
      fetched[table] = await fetchAllRows(
        table,
        session.user.id,
        isFirstSync ? null : lastSync
      );
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(`Error fetching ${table}:`, err.message);
      if (isFirstSync) throw err;
      fetched[table] = [];
    }
  }

  for (const table of tables) {
    const rows = fetched[table];
    
    if (isFirstSync) {
      await db.table(table).clear();
    }

    if (!rows || rows.length === 0) continue;

    // Protect pending local edits from being overwritten by older cloud data
    const existingRows = await db.table(table).toArray();
    const existingMap = new Map(existingRows.map(r => [r.uuid, r]));

    const toPut = rows.map(row => {
      // eslint-disable-next-line no-unused-vars
      const { user_id, id, ...rest } = row;
      
      const cloudUpdated = new Date(row.updated_at).getTime();
      const localRow = existingMap.get(id);
      
      // If local is pending and has a newer timestamp, DON'T overwrite it
      if (localRow && localRow.syncStatus === 'pending') {
        const localUpdated = new Date(localRow.updated_at).getTime();
        if (localUpdated > cloudUpdated) {
          return null; 
        }
      }

      return {
        ...rest,
        uuid: id, 
        syncStatus: 'synced',
      };
    }).filter(Boolean); // Remove nulls

    if (table === 'settings') {
      await db.settings.bulkPut(toPut);
    } else {
      if (toPut.length > 0) {
        await db.table(table).bulkPut(toPut);
      }
    }
  }

  setLastSync(now);
}

export async function syncAll() {
  const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
  if (!session) return;

  const lastSync = getLastSync();

  if (!lastSync) {
    const { count, error } = await supabase
      .from('transactions')
      .select('*', { count: 'exact', head: true })
      .eq('user_id', session.user.id);

    if (!error && count === 0) {
      await db.transactions.toCollection().modify({ syncStatus: 'pending' });
      await db.settings.toCollection().modify({ syncStatus: 'pending' });
      await db.loans.toCollection().modify({ syncStatus: 'pending' });
      await db.bucket_map.toCollection().modify({ syncStatus: 'pending' });
      await pushChanges();
      setLastSync(new Date().toISOString());
    } else {
      await pullChanges(true);
    }
    return;
  }

  // PUSH FIRST. If push fails, abort pull to prevent duplicates.
  const pushSuccess = await pushChanges();
  if (pushSuccess) {
    await pullChanges(false);
  } else {
    console.warn('Push failed. Aborting pull to prevent data loss/duplication.');
  }
}

// Register the Service Worker for PWA (Production only)
if ('serviceWorker' in navigator && import.meta.env.PROD) {
  window.addEventListener('load', () => {
    navigator.serviceWorker.register('/sw.js').then(
      (registration) => {
        console.log('SW registered: ', registration);
        
        // Force a check for a new service worker on every load
        registration.update();

        // If a new service worker is found, activate it and reload the page once
        registration.onupdatefound = () => {
          const installingWorker = registration.installing;
          if (installingWorker == null) return;
          installingWorker.onstatechange = () => {
            if (installingWorker.state === 'installed' && navigator.serviceWorker.controller) {
              console.log('New content is available; please refresh.');
              window.location.reload();
            }
          };
        };
      },
      (registrationError) => {
        console.log('SW registration failed: ', registrationError);
      }
    );
  });
}

import { create } from 'zustand';
import { db } from '../db/database';
import { v4 as uuidv4 } from 'uuid';

export const useStore = create((set, get) => ({
  transactions: [],
  settings: {},
  loans: [],
  bucketMap: [],
  zakatLog: [],
  isLoading: true,

  loadData: async () => {
    set({ isLoading: true });
    // Filter out deleted rows, but allow rows where 'deleted' is undefined (legacy data)
    const transactions = await db.transactions.filter(t => t.deleted !== true).toArray();
    const settingsArray = await db.settings.filter(s => s.deleted !== true).toArray();
    const loans = await db.loans.filter(l => l.deleted !== true).toArray();
    const bucketMap = await db.bucket_map.filter(b => b.deleted !== true).toArray();
    const zakatLog = await db.zakat_log.toArray();

    const settings = settingsArray.reduce((acc, item) => {
      acc[item.key] = item.value;
      return acc;
    }, {});

    set({ transactions, settings, loans, bucketMap, zakatLog, isLoading: false });
  },

  updateSetting: async (key, value) => {
    const { settings } = get();
    if (JSON.stringify(settings[key]) === JSON.stringify(value)) return;

    await db.settings.put({
      key,
      value,
      syncStatus: 'pending',
      updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      deleted: false,
    });
    set((state) => ({
      settings: { ...state.settings, [key]: value },
    }));
  },

  // ============ BUCKET MAP ============
  getBucketFromMap: (category, subcategory) => {
    const { bucketMap } = get();
    const row = bucketMap.find(
      r => r.category === category && r.subcategory === subcategory
    );
    return row ? row.bucket : 'Discretionary';
  },

  updateBucketFor: async (category, subcategory, newBucket) => {
    const { bucketMap } = get();
    const existing = bucketMap.find(
      r => r.category === category && r.subcategory === subcategory
    );

    if (existing) {
      await db.bucket_map.update(existing.id, {
        bucket: newBucket,
        syncStatus: 'pending',
        updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      });
      set((state) => ({
        bucketMap: state.bucketMap.map(r =>
          r.id === existing.id
            ? { ...r, bucket: newBucket, syncStatus: 'pending', updated_at: new Date().toISOString() }
            : r
        ),
      }));
    } else {
      const newRow = {
        category,
        subcategory,
        bucket: newBucket,
        uuid: uuidv4(),
        syncStatus: 'pending',
        updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        deleted: false,
      };
      const id = await db.bucket_map.add(newRow);
      set((state) => ({
        bucketMap: [...state.bucketMap, { ...newRow, id }],
      }));
    }
  },

  getSubcategoriesFor: (category) => {
    const { bucketMap } = get();
    return bucketMap
      .filter(r => r.category === category && r.deleted !== true)
      .map(r => r.subcategory);
  },

  getCategories: () => {
    const { bucketMap } = get();
    return [...new Set(bucketMap.filter(r => r.deleted !== true).map(r => r.category))];
  },

  // ============ LOANS ============
  addLoan: async (loanData) => {
    const uuid = uuidv4();
    const newLoan = {
      ...loanData,
      uuid,
      syncStatus: 'pending',
      updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      deleted: false,
    };
    const id = await db.loans.add(newLoan);
    set((state) => ({
      loans: [...state.loans, { ...newLoan, id }],
    }));
    return uuid;
  },

  updateLoan: async (id, updates) => {
    const updateData = {
      ...updates,
      syncStatus: 'pending',
      updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    };
    await db.loans.update(id, updateData);
    set((state) => ({
      loans: state.loans.map(l => (l.id === id ? { ...l, ...updateData } : l)),
    }));
  },

  deleteLoan: async (id) => {
    const target = get().loans.find(l => l.id === id);
    const targetUuid = target?.uuid;

    await db.loans.update(id, {
      deleted: true,
      syncStatus: 'pending',
      updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    });

    const linked = get().transactions.filter(t => t.loan_uuid === targetUuid);
    for (const t of linked) {
      await db.transactions.update(t.id, {
        loan_uuid: null,
        syncStatus: 'pending',
        updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      });
    }

    set((state) => ({
      loans: state.loans.filter(l => l.id !== id),
      transactions: state.transactions.map(t =>
        t.loan_uuid === targetUuid ? { ...t, loan_uuid: null, syncStatus: 'pending' } : t
      ),
    }));
  },

  getLoanPaid: (loanIdentifier) => {
    const { transactions, loans } = get();
    const loan = loans.find(l => l.uuid === loanIdentifier || l.id === loanIdentifier);
    if (!loan) return 0;

    return transactions
      .filter(t =>
        t.loan_uuid === loan.uuid &&
        t.type === 'Expense' &&
        t.deleted !== true
      )
      .reduce((sum, t) => sum + (t.amount_mvr || 0), 0);
  },

  getTotalDebtPayable: () => {
    const { loans } = get();
    let total = 0;
    for (const loan of loans) {
      if (loan.deleted === true) continue;
      const paid = get().getLoanPaid(loan.uuid);
      total += Math.max(0, (loan.total_amount || 0) - paid);
    }
    return total;
  },

  // ============ TRANSACTIONS ============
  addTransaction: async (transactionData) => {
    const { settings } = get();
    const currentRate = settings.current_usd_rate || 15.42;

    let amount_mvr = transactionData.amount_original;
    if (transactionData.currency === 'USD') {
      amount_mvr = transactionData.amount_original * currentRate;
    }

    const newTransaction = {
      ...transactionData,
      amount_mvr,
      exchange_rate_at_time: currentRate,
      is_historical: false,
      date: transactionData.date || new Date().toISOString(),
      uuid: uuidv4(),
      syncStatus: 'pending',
      updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      deleted: false,
    };

    const id = await db.transactions.add(newTransaction);

    set((state) => ({
      transactions: [...state.transactions, { ...newTransaction, id }],
    }));
  },

  updateTransaction: async (id, updates) => {
    const { settings } = get();
    const existing = get().transactions.find(t => t.id === id);
    if (!existing) return;

    const currentRate =
      updates.exchange_rate_at_time ||
      existing.exchange_rate_at_time ||
      settings.current_usd_rate ||
      15.42;

    let amount_mvr =
      updates.amount_original !== undefined
        ? updates.amount_original
        : existing.amount_original;
    if ((updates.currency || existing.currency) === 'USD') {
      amount_mvr = amount_mvr * currentRate;
    }

    const updated = {
      ...existing,
      ...updates,
      amount_mvr,
      exchange_rate_at_time: currentRate,
      syncStatus: 'pending',
      updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    };

    await db.transactions.put(updated);

    set((state) => ({
      transactions: state.transactions.map(t => (t.id === id ? updated : t)),
    }));
  },

  deleteTransaction: async (id) => {
    await db.transactions.update(id, {
      deleted: true,
      syncStatus: 'pending',
      updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    });
    set((state) => ({
      transactions: state.transactions.filter(t => t.id !== id),
    }));
  },

  // ============ CALCULATIONS ============
  getBucketBalances: (monthString) => {
    const { transactions, settings } = get();
    const monthTransactions = transactions.filter(
      t => t.date.startsWith(monthString) && !t.is_historical && t.deleted !== true
    );

    const totalIncome = monthTransactions
      .filter(t => t.type === 'Income')
      .reduce((sum, t) => sum + (t.amount_mvr || 0), 0);

    const ePct = Number(settings.essential_pct) || 40;
    const dPct = Number(settings.discretionary_pct) || 10;
    const fPct = Number(settings.financial_pct) || 15;
    const sPct = Number(settings.savings_pct) || 35;

    const essentialAllocated = totalIncome * (ePct / 100);
    const discretionaryAllocated = totalIncome * (dPct / 100);
    const financialAllocated = totalIncome * (fPct / 100);
    const savingsAllocated = totalIncome * (sPct / 100);

    const essentialSpent = monthTransactions
      .filter(t => t.type === 'Expense' && t.bucket === 'Essential')
      .reduce((sum, t) => sum + (t.amount_mvr || 0), 0);
    const discretionarySpent = monthTransactions
      .filter(t => t.type === 'Expense' && t.bucket === 'Discretionary')
      .reduce((sum, t) => sum + (t.amount_mvr || 0), 0);
    const financialSpent = monthTransactions
      .filter(t => t.type === 'Expense' && t.bucket === 'Financial/Obligatory')
      .reduce((sum, t) => sum + (t.amount_mvr || 0), 0);

    return {
      Essential: { allocated: essentialAllocated, spent: essentialSpent, remaining: essentialAllocated - essentialSpent },
      Discretionary: { allocated: discretionaryAllocated, spent: discretionarySpent, remaining: discretionaryAllocated - discretionarySpent },
      Financial: { allocated: financialAllocated, spent: financialSpent, remaining: financialAllocated - financialSpent },
      Savings: { allocated: savingsAllocated, spent: 0, remaining: savingsAllocated },
    };
  },

  getCategoryTotals: (monthString, includeHistorical = false) => {
    const { transactions } = get();
    const monthExpenses = transactions.filter(
      t =>
        t.date.startsWith(monthString) &&
        t.type === 'Expense' &&
        t.deleted !== true &&
        (includeHistorical || !t.is_historical) &&
        Number.isFinite(t.amount_mvr)
    );

    const byCategory = {};

    monthExpenses.forEach(t => {
      const cat = t.category || '(Uncategorized)';
      const sub = t.subcategory || '(No subcategory)';

      if (!byCategory[cat]) {
        byCategory[cat] = { category: cat, amount: 0, subcategories: {} };
      }
      if (!byCategory[cat].subcategories[sub]) {
        byCategory[cat].subcategories[sub] = { subcategory: sub, amount: 0, count: 0 };
      }

      byCategory[cat].amount += t.amount_mvr;
      byCategory[cat].subcategories[sub].amount += t.amount_mvr;
      byCategory[cat].subcategories[sub].count += 1;
    });

    const totals = Object.values(byCategory)
      .map(c => ({
        category: c.category,
        amount: c.amount,
        subcategories: Object.values(c.subcategories).sort((a, b) => b.amount - a.amount),
      }))
      .sort((a, b) => b.amount - a.amount);

    const grandTotal = totals.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.amount, 0);

    return { totals, grandTotal };
  },

  getMonthTransactions: (monthString, includeHistorical = false) => {
    const { transactions } = get();
    return transactions
      .filter(
        t =>
          t.date.startsWith(monthString) &&
          t.deleted !== true &&
          (includeHistorical || !t.is_historical)
      )
      .sort((a, b) => new Date(b.date) - new Date(a.date));
  },

  // ============ ZAKAT LOGIC ============
  calculateZakat: (monthString) => {
    const { transactions, settings } = get();

    const zakatPaidThisMonth = transactions
      .filter(
        t =>
          t.type === 'Expense' &&
          t.category === 'Personal' &&
          t.subcategory === 'Zakat' &&
          t.date.startsWith(monthString) &&
          !t.is_historical &&
          t.deleted !== true
      )
      .reduce((sum, t) => sum + (t.amount_mvr || 0), 0);

    let bankBalance;
    if (
      settings.bank_balance_override !== undefined &&
      settings.bank_balance_override !== null &&
      settings.bank_balance_override !== ''
    ) {
      bankBalance = parseFloat(settings.bank_balance_override) || 0;
    } else {
      const totalIncome = transactions
        .filter(t => t.type === 'Income' && !t.is_historical && t.deleted !== true)
        .reduce((sum, t) => sum + (t.amount_mvr || 0), 0);
      const totalExpenses = transactions
        .filter(t => t.type === 'Expense' && !t.is_historical && t.deleted !== true)
        .reduce((sum, t) => sum + (t.amount_mvr || 0), 0);
      bankBalance = totalIncome - totalExpenses;
    }

    const bankBalanceBeforeZakat = bankBalance + zakatPaidThisMonth;
    const debtPayable = get().getTotalDebtPayable();
    const debtReceivable = parseFloat(settings.debt_receivable) || 0;
    const nisab = parseFloat(settings.nisab_threshold) || 10000;

    const monthKey = monthString.slice(5, 7);
    const prevYearBalances = settings.prev_year_balances || {};
    const lastYearBalance = parseFloat(prevYearBalances[monthKey]) || 0;

    const eligible =
      bankBalanceBeforeZakat > lastYearBalance || bankBalanceBeforeZakat > nisab;

    const zakatableAmount = bankBalanceBeforeZakat - debtPayable + debtReceivable;
    const baseZakat = eligible && zakatableAmount > 0 ? zakatableAmount * 0.025 : 0;

    const zakatDue = Math.max(0, baseZakat - zakatPaidThisMonth);
    const fullyPaid = baseZakat > 0 && zakatDue === 0;

    return {
      bankBalance,
      bankBalanceBeforeZakat,
      debtPayable,
      debtReceivable,
      nisab,
      lastYearBalance,
      zakatableAmount,
      baseZakat,
      zakatPaidThisMonth,
      zakatDue,
      eligible,
      fullyPaid,
    };
  },

  // ============ RANGE + YEARLY ============
  getTransactionsInRange: (fromISO, toISO, opts = {}) => {
    const { includeHistorical = true, type = 'All', category = null } = opts;
    const { transactions } = get();

    let from = null;
    if (fromISO) {
      const d = new Date(fromISO);
      d.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
      from = d.getTime();
    }

    let to = null;
    if (toISO) {
      const d = new Date(toISO);
      d.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999);
      to = d.getTime();
    }

    return transactions
      .filter(t => {
        if (t.deleted === true) return false;
        if (!includeHistorical && t.is_historical) return false;
        if (type !== 'All' && t.type !== type) return false;
        if (category && t.category !== category) return false;

        const d = new Date(t.date).getTime();
        if (from !== null && d < from) return false;
        if (to !== null && d > to) return false;
        return true;
      })
      .sort((a, b) => new Date(b.date) - new Date(a.date));
  },

  aggregateRange: (rows) => {
    const buildGroup = (typeFilter) => {
      const map = {};

      rows.forEach(t => {
        if (t.type !== typeFilter) return;
        if (!Number.isFinite(t.amount_mvr)) return;

        const cat = t.category || '(Uncategorized)';
        const sub = t.subcategory || '(No subcategory)';

        if (!map[cat]) map[cat] = { category: cat, total: 0, subcategories: {} };
        if (!map[cat].subcategories[sub]) {
          map[cat].subcategories[sub] = { subcategory: sub, total: 0, count: 0 };
        }

        map[cat].total += t.amount_mvr;
        map[cat].subcategories[sub].total += t.amount_mvr;
        map[cat].subcategories[sub].count += 1;
      });

      const categories = Object.values(map)
        .map(c => ({
          category: c.category,
          total: c.total,
          subcategories: Object.values(c.subcategories).sort((a, b) => b.total - a.total),
        }))
        .sort((a, b) => b.total - a.total);

      const grandTotal = categories.reduce((sum, c) => sum + c.total, 0);
      return { categories, grandTotal };
    };

    return {
      expenses: buildGroup('Expense'),
      incomes: buildGroup('Income'),
    };
  },

  getYearlySummary: (type = 'Expense') => {
    const { transactions } = get();

    const txFiltered = transactions.filter(
      t => t.type === type && t.deleted !== true && Number.isFinite(t.amount_mvr)
    );

    const yearSet = new Set();
    txFiltered.forEach(t => {
      const y = new Date(t.date).getFullYear();
      if (!isNaN(y)) yearSet.add(y);
    });
    const years = Array.from(yearSet).sort((a, b) => a - b);

    const catMap = {};
    txFiltered.forEach(t => {
      const y = new Date(t.date).getFullYear();
      if (isNaN(y)) return;

      const cat = t.category || '(Uncategorized)';
      if (!catMap[cat]) {
        catMap[cat] = { category: cat, byYear: {} };
        years.forEach(yy => {
          catMap[cat].byYear[yy] = 0;
        });
      }
      catMap[cat].byYear[y] = (catMap[cat].byYear[y] || 0) + t.amount_mvr;
    });

    const rows = Object.values(catMap)
      .map(r => {
        const total = years.reduce((sum, y) => sum + (r.byYear[y] || 0), 0);
        const activeYears = years.filter(y => (r.byYear[y] || 0) > 0);
        const avg = activeYears.length > 0 ? total / activeYears.length : 0;
        return { ...r, total, avg };
      })
      .sort((a, b) => b.total - a.total);

    const grandTotalByYear = {};
    years.forEach(y => {
      grandTotalByYear[y] = rows.reduce((sum, r) => sum + (r.byYear[y] || 0), 0);
    });

    const grandTotal = rows.reduce((sum, r) => sum + r.total, 0);

    return { years, rows, grandTotalByYear, grandTotal };
  },

  getSubcategoryYearlySummary: (targetCategory, years, type = 'Expense') => {
    const { transactions } = get();

    const catTx = transactions.filter(
      t =>
        t.type === type &&
        t.category === targetCategory &&
        t.deleted !== true &&
        Number.isFinite(t.amount_mvr)
    );

    const subMap = {};
    catTx.forEach(t => {
      const y = new Date(t.date).getFullYear();
      if (isNaN(y)) return;

      const sub = t.subcategory || '(No subcategory)';
      if (!subMap[sub]) {
        subMap[sub] = { subcategory: sub, byYear: {} };
        years.forEach(yy => {
          subMap[sub].byYear[yy] = 0;
        });
      }
      subMap[sub].byYear[y] = (subMap[sub].byYear[y] || 0) + t.amount_mvr;
    });

    return Object.values(subMap)
      .map(r => {
        const total = years.reduce((sum, y) => sum + (r.byYear[y] || 0), 0);
        const activeYears = years.filter(y => (r.byYear[y] || 0) > 0);
        const avg = activeYears.length > 0 ? total / activeYears.length : 0;
        return { ...r, total, avg };
      })
      .sort((a, b) => b.total - a.total);
  },
}));

import * as XLSX from 'xlsx';

export function exportMasterSheet(expenseData, incomeData) {
  const wb = XLSX.utils.book_new();

  const addSheetsForData = (data, prefix) => {
    const { years, rows, grandTotalByYear, grandTotal } = data;
    if (years.length === 0) return; // Skip if no data for this type

    // ---- Sheet 1: Master Matrix ----
    const header = ['Category', ...years, 'Avg', 'Total'];
    const body = rows.map(r => [
      r.category,
      ...years.map(y => r.byYear[y] || 0),
      Number(r.avg.toFixed(2)),
      Number(r.total.toFixed(2)),
    ]);

    const totalRow = [
      `All ${prefix}s`,
      ...years.map(y => grandTotalByYear[y] || 0),
      '',
      Number(grandTotal.toFixed(2)),
    ];

    const master = XLSX.utils.aoa_to_sheet([header, ...body, totalRow]);

    master['!cols'] = [
      { wch: 20 },
      ...years.map(() => ({ wch: 12 })),
      { wch: 12 },
      { wch: 14 },
    ];

    XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(wb, master, `${prefix} Master`);

    // ---- Sheet 2: Averages & Totals ----
    const summaryHeader = ['Category', 'All Time Avg', 'All Time Total'];
    const summaryBody = rows.map(r => [
      r.category,
      Number(r.avg.toFixed(2)),
      Number(r.total.toFixed(2)),
    ]);
    const summarySheet = XLSX.utils.aoa_to_sheet([summaryHeader, ...summaryBody]);
    summarySheet['!cols'] = [{ wch: 20 }, { wch: 14 }, { wch: 14 }];
    XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(wb, summarySheet, `${prefix} Averages`);

    // ---- Sheet 3: Year Totals ----
    const yearHeader = ['Year', 'Grand Total'];
    const yearBody = years.map(y => [y, Number((grandTotalByYear[y] || 0).toFixed(2))]);
    const yearSheet = XLSX.utils.aoa_to_sheet([yearHeader, ...yearBody]);
    yearSheet['!cols'] = [{ wch: 10 }, { wch: 16 }];
    XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(wb, yearSheet, `${prefix} Year Totals`);
  };

  // Generate the sheets for both types
  addSheetsForData(expenseData, 'Expense');
  addSheetsForData(incomeData, 'Income');

  // Save the file
  const stamp = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  XLSX.writeFile(wb, `finance-master-${stamp}.xlsx`);
}

// src/utils/format.js

export function formatMoney(amount) {
  if (amount === undefined || amount === null || isNaN(amount)) return '0.00';
  
  return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', {
    minimumFractionDigits: 2,
    maximumFractionDigits: 2,
  }).format(amount);
}

import react from '@vitejs/plugin-react'
import { defineConfig } from 'vite'

// https://vite.dev/config/
export default defineConfig({
